datasets.name: acrima
datasets.full_name: ACRIMA: Glaucoma Optic Disc Fundus Database
datasets.description: 705 optic disc-centred fundus photographs (396 normal + 309 glaucoma) from Hospital Clinico San Carlos. Expert-annotated binary glaucoma classification.
datasets.citation: Diaz-Pinto et al., 'Retinal Image Synthesis and Semi-Supervised Learning for Glaucoma Assessment', IEEE TMI 2019. Data: https://figshare.com/s/c2d31f850af14c5b5232

datasets.name: adam_challenge
datasets.full_name: ADAM — Automatic Detection of AMD Challenge
datasets.description: 1200 fundus images for AMD classification, five-class lesion segmentation, fovea/optic disc localisation.
datasets.citation: Fang H. et al., 'ADAM Challenge: Detecting AMD from Fundus Images', IEEE TMI 2022.

datasets.name: afio_fundus_vessels
datasets.full_name: AFIO Fundus Images for Vessel Segmentation and Disease Annotation
datasets.description: One hundred retinal fundus images from Armed Forces Institute of Ophthalmology, Rawalpindi, with expert annotations for vessels and hypertensive retinopathy, diabetic retinopathy, and papilledema tasks.
datasets.citation: Akram MU et al. Data on Fundus Images for Vessels Segmentation, Detection of Hypertensive Retinopathy, Diabetic Retinopathy and Papilledema. Mendeley Data, V2, 2019. doi:10.17632/3csr652p9y.2
datasets.notes: Mendeley Data may block automated URL probes with HTTP 403 (no bot allowed); browser link is valid.

datasets.name: agar300
datasets.description: The first public AGAR300 release contains 28 color fundus images with microaneurysms, captured at a 45 degree field of view and 2448 by 3264 pixel resolution.
datasets.citation: Derwin J, Shan P. Diabetic Retinopathy - Fundus Image Dataset (AGAR300). IEEE DataPort. 2020. doi:10.21227/fsnq-tn19
datasets.notes: The source paper describes a larger 300 image clinical collection. The DOI record states that the public first release contains 28 images. All released images contain microaneurysms, and the release does not include spatial annotations. An IEEE DataPort account may be required to download it.

datasets.name: age_challenge
datasets.description: 4800 AS-OCT images from 199 patients. Two tasks: angle closure classification and scleral spur localization.
datasets.citation: Fu H. et al., 'AGE Challenge: Angle Closure Glaucoma Evaluation', MICCAI 2019 Workshop.

datasets.name: airogs
datasets.full_name: AIROGS: AI for Robust Glaucoma Screening
datasets.description: ~113,893 color fundus images labelled as referable glaucoma (RG), no referable glaucoma (NRG), or ungradable. Large-scale, multi-ethnic, multi-site screening dataset.
datasets.citation: De Vente et al., 'AIROGS: Artificial Intelligence for Robust Glaucoma Screening Challenge', TMI 2023.
datasets.notes: Training set (~101k images) on Zenodo. Test set distributed through Grand Challenge. Requires free account for Grand Challenge.

datasets.name: amd_dme_3d_oct
datasets.full_name: Comprehensive 3D OCT Dataset for AMD and DME
datasets.description: Swept-source OCT volumes for AMD and DME with three-dimensional pigment epithelial detachment and intraretinal-fluid masks.
datasets.citation: Huang W, Qin L, Xu M, et al. Comprehensive 3D Optical Coherence Tomography Dataset for AMD and DME: Facilitating Deep-Learning-Based 3D Segmentation. Scientific Data. 2026;13:224. doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06497-1
datasets.notes: The release contains 122 AMD and 102 DME volumes. Of these, 104 volumes are labeled (62 AMD and 42 DME) and 120 are unlabeled.

datasets.name: amd_sd
datasets.full_name: AMD-SD: OCT Wet AMD Lesion Segmentation Dataset
datasets.description: 3,049 OCT B-scan images (1,140×380 px) from 138 wet AMD patients (156 eyes) with pixel-level annotations for 5 lesion classes: Subretinal Fluid (SRF), Intraretinal Fluid (IRF), Ellipsoid Zone Continuity (EZC), Subretinal Hyperreflective Material (SHRM), and Pigment Epithelial Detachment (PED).
datasets.citation: Hu Y et al., 'AMD-SD: An Optical Coherence Tomography Image Dataset for wet AMD Lesions Segmentation', Scientific Data 11, 1014 (2024). doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03844-6
datasets.notes: Official split: training.txt / validation.txt at dataset root. Images in AMD-SD/images/<patient_id>/<scan>.png. Primary source: Figshare collection 7157554; mirror on Kaggle: gaoweihao/amd-sd.

datasets.name: amdnet23
datasets.full_name: AMDNet23 Fundus Image Dataset for AMD Detection
datasets.description: Two thousand preprocessed fundus images compiled from six public sources for normal, diabetes, cataract, and age-related macular degeneration classification.
datasets.citation: Ali MA. AMDNet23: Fundus Image Dataset for Age-Related Macular Degeneration Disease Detection. Mendeley Data, V1, 2025. doi:10.17632/yj35kjgrv3.1
datasets.notes: Composite/preprocessed dataset compiled from ODIR, DR_200, Fundus Dataset, RFMiD, HRF, and ARIA; avoid treating it as an independent primary cohort.

datasets.name: angioreport
datasets.description: De-identified fluorescein and indocyanine-green angiography images paired with structured lesion descriptions and reports.
datasets.license: Unknown; competition data terms must be reviewed
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; competition data terms must be reviewed
datasets.citation: Xu P, Chotcomwongse P, Zhang W, et al. AngioReport: Dataset and baseline methods for fundus angiography report generation. British Journal of Ophthalmology. 2025;109:1283-1288. doi:10.1136/bjo-2024-327006
datasets.notes: The paper reports 55,361 images from 1,691 patients and 3,179 eyes across 24 diagnostic conditions. Access is routed through the 2023 APTOS/Tianchi competition page; no clear dataset license was visible, so users must review current platform terms.

datasets.name: anterior_segment_smile
datasets.full_name: Anterior Segment Parameters After SMILE Surgery
datasets.description: Tabular anterior-segment and ocular-biometry measurements before and after SMILE surgery, including slit-lamp examination, Pentacam, and IOLMaster variables.
datasets.citation: Sun C. Anterior Segment Parameter Analysis After SMILE Surgery and Its Impact on the Calculation of Effective Intraocular Lens Position. Mendeley Data, V1, 2026. doi:10.17632/vkdxsnhkrm.1
datasets.notes: Source page reports clinical examination, Pentacam, and IOLMaster measurements; sample count was not exposed during curation.

datasets.name: aod
datasets.description: Augmented ODIR-5K fundus photographs for 8-class ocular disease classification: Normal, Diabetes, Glaucoma, Cataract, AMD, Hypertension, Myopia, Other. Preprocessing includes CLAHE and standard augmentation.
datasets.citation: AOD Dataset. Kaggle. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/nurmukhammed7/augemnted-ocular-diseases
datasets.notes: OVERLAP: AOD is an augmented variant of ODIR-2019 (already in EyeDataHub as `odir2019`). Preprocessing (CLAHE) and augmentation explain the 14,813 vs 16,000 image count delta. Kept because the augmented split appears in downstream benchmarks separately.

datasets.name: aptos2019
datasets.description: 3662 fundus images from Aravind Eye Hospital, graded 0-4 for diabetic retinopathy severity.
datasets.citation: Karthik et al., APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection. Kaggle competition, 2019.

datasets.name: aptos_arcade_onh_masks
datasets.full_name: APTOS Vascular Arcade and Optic Nerve Head Masks
datasets.description: Segmentation masks for the vascular arcade and optic nerve head derived from APTOS 2019 fundus images.
datasets.citation: APTOS vascular arcade and optic nerve head masks. Zenodo, 2026. doi:10.5281/zenodo.20711325
datasets.notes: Derivative annotation layer for APTOS 2019; does not represent a new image cohort.

datasets.name: aroi
datasets.full_name: AROI: Annotated Retinal OCT Images Database
datasets.description: 1,136 OCT B-scans from 24 AMD patients. Expert annotations for 3 retinal fluid types (IRF, SRF, PED) and 3 retinal layer boundaries for joint layer and fluid segmentation.
datasets.license: Research only — cite required papers (see citation field)
datasets.source_terms: Research only — cite required papers (see citation field)
datasets.citation: M. Melinščak, M. Radmilović, Z. Vatavuk, S. Lončarić, 'Annotated retinal optical coherence tomography images (AROI) database for joint retinal layer and fluid segmentation', Automatika, vol. 62, no. 3, pp. 375–385, Jul. 2021. doi:10.1080/00051144.2021.1973298 | M. Melinščak et al., 'AROI: Annotated Retinal OCT Images database', MIPRO 2021, pp. 400–405 | M. Melinščak, 'Attention-based U-net: Joint segmentation of layers and fluids from retinal OCT images', MIPRO 2023, pp. 391–396 | M. Melinščak, 'Enhancing Interpretability in Retinal OCT Analysis Using Grad-CAM: A Study on the AROI Dataset', MIPRO 2025, pp. 1433–1438.

datasets.name: aroma_octa
datasets.description: Retinal OCTA scans labeled for artifact type, artifact severity, signal strength, and image quality.
datasets.citation: Szwarcberg L, Anwer A, Gozlan A, et al. The AROMA Dataset for Automatic Detection of Artifact Type and Severity in Retinal Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography. Ophthalmic Research. 2026. doi:10.1159/000551126
datasets.notes: The source reports 281 scans from 115 patients. Fourteen en-face images per scan yield 3,934 derived images with seven artifact types graded on a four-level severity scale.

datasets.name: as_oct_keratitis
datasets.description: 1,168 anterior-segment OCT images of keratitis with per-pixel lesion, cornea, and iris segmentation labels. Enables 3D reconstruction from B-scan stacks.
datasets.citation: Sun Y, et al., 'An AS-OCT image dataset for deep learning-enabled segmentation and 3D reconstruction for keratitis', Scientific Data 2024.
datasets.notes: Adds corneal infectious disease + 3D AS-OCT use case.

datasets.name: bajwa_multi_eye
datasets.full_name: Bajwa Hospital Multi Eye Disease Dataset
datasets.description: Small four-class eye-disease image dataset with normal, cataract, glaucoma, and retinal disease categories.
datasets.citation: Kaur P. Bajwa Hospital (Multi Eye Disease Dataset). Mendeley Data, V3, 2022. doi:10.17632/rgwpd4m785.3

datasets.name: beh
datasets.full_name: BEH: Bangladesh Eye Hospital Glaucoma Dataset
datasets.description: Fundus photographs from Bangladesh Eye Hospital for glaucoma detection. Includes optic cup/disc crops and vessel segmentation masks alongside binary glaucoma/normal labels.
datasets.citation: Islam MT et al., 'Deep Learning-Based Glaucoma Detection with Cropped Optic Cup and Disc and Blood Vessel Segmentation', IEEE Access 2022. https://github.com/mirtanvirislam/Deep-Learning-Based-Glaucoma-Detection-with-Cropped-Optic-Cup-and-Disc-and-Blood-Vessel-Segmentation

datasets.name: belo
datasets.full_name: BELO Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models in Ophthalmology
datasets.description: Expert-curated ophthalmology multiple-choice benchmark with rationales, assembled for held-out language-model evaluation.
datasets.citation: BELO: A Benchmark for Evaluation of Language Models in Ophthalmology. Ophthalmology Science. 2025:101050. doi:10.1016/j.xops.2025.101050
datasets.notes: The 900 questions aggregate BCSC, BioASQ, MedMCQA, MedQA, and PubMedQA sources. The project page instructs users to request the held-out benchmark by email; verify every applicable source term.

datasets.name: bidr
datasets.description: 35,126 fundus images for 5-class diabetic retinopathy grading (No DR: 25,810 / Mild: 2,443 / Moderate: 5,292 / Severe: 873 / Proliferative: 708). Available via Kaggle.
datasets.citation: BiDR Dataset. Kaggle. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/pkdarabi/diagnosis-of-diabetic-retinopathy
datasets.notes: OVERLAP: BiDR is a Kaggle re-upload of the EyePACS Kaggle 2015 competition TRAIN split (35,126 images). Already in EyeDataHub as `eyepacs` (full 88,702 train+test) and also as `dr_arranged` (Tianchi mirror of the same train split). Kept for users who specifically reference the BiDR slug.

datasets.name: birdshot_wide
datasets.description: Longitudinal widefield fundus photographs from birdshot chorioretinitis eyes and age- and sex-matched controls.
datasets.citation: Foulonneau T, Memmi C, Monnet D, Brezin AP, Vienne-Jumeau A. A Dataset of Widefield Fundus Images From Patients With Birdshot Chorioretinitis and Matched Control. Scientific Data. 2026. doi:10.1038/s41597-026-07494-8
datasets.notes: Restricted Zenodo record requiring an access request. The source reports 5,042 images from 742 affected eyes and 1,310 images from 742 matched control eyes; the birdshot cohort has a median 4.31-year follow-up. CC BY 4.0 does not remove the access agreement.

datasets.name: bmrd
datasets.description: One thousand seven hundred eighty-six original color fundus images for diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and glaucoma grading/classification.
datasets.citation: Ema RR. Bangladesh Multi-Disease Retinal Dataset (BMRD). Mendeley Data, V1, 2025. doi:10.17632/959whsbc6v.1

datasets.name: brset
datasets.description: 16,266 color fundus images from 8,524 Brazilian patients with 14 disease labels (DR, AMD, glaucoma, drusen, others), image quality flags, and demographic attributes.
datasets.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (Research only)
datasets.source_terms: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (Research only)
datasets.citation: Nakayama LF, Restrepo D, Matos J, et al., 'BRSET: A Brazilian Multilabel Ophthalmological Dataset of Retina Fundus Photos', PLOS Digital Health 3(7):e0000454, 2024. doi:10.1371/journal.pdig.0000454 · PhysioNet DOI: 10.13026/1pht-2b69
datasets.notes: Requires PhysioNet credentialed-user account + CITI training + signed Data Use Agreement. Set PHYSIONET_USERNAME and PHYSIONET_PASSWORD in .env to auto-download.

datasets.name: brset_mbrset_embeddings
datasets.full_name: Embedding-Based Representations for BRSET and mBRSET
datasets.description: Precomputed image embeddings for BRSET and mBRSET to support efficient ophthalmic AI research without raw-image redistribution.
datasets.citation: Embedding-Based Representations for BRSET and mBRSET. PhysioNet, 2026.
datasets.notes: Derivative representation layer for existing BRSET/mBRSET cohorts.

datasets.name: cadis
datasets.full_name: CaDIS: Cataract Dataset for Image Segmentation
datasets.description: Semantic segmentation labels for 4,670 frames from 25 cataract surgery videos (CATARACTS challenge). 25 anatomy and instrument classes.
datasets.citation: Grammatikopoulou M, Flouty E, Kadkhodamohammadi A, et al., 'CaDIS: Cataract dataset for image segmentation', arXiv 1906.11586, 2019.
datasets.notes: Standard cataract-scene segmentation benchmark. Grand Challenge account required.

datasets.name: casia_iris_v4
datasets.description: Six near-infrared or synthetic iris subsets spanning close-range, lamp variation, twins, distance, large-scale, and synthetic recognition.
datasets.license: Public domain; source access terms apply
datasets.source_terms: Public domain; source access terms apply
datasets.citation: Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute of Automation. CASIA Iris Image Database Version 4.0. Dataset documentation.
datasets.notes: The project documentation mirror reports 54,601 images from more than 1,800 genuine and 1,000 virtual subjects, with possible subject overlap across four subsets, and describes the release as public domain. The linked download service may require login.

datasets.name: cataract
datasets.description: 601 fundus images in 4 classes: Normal, Cataract, Glaucoma, and Retina Disease. Intended for ocular disease classification.
datasets.citation: Kaggle dataset by jr2ngb (2019). https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jr2ngb/cataractdataset

datasets.name: cataract101_extended_labels
datasets.description: Extended phase/time labels for the Cataract-101 surgical-video dataset.
datasets.citation: Cataract101 extended labels. Zenodo, 2021. doi:10.5281/zenodo.4984167
datasets.notes: Derivative label layer for existing `cataract_101` images/videos.

datasets.name: cataract1k
datasets.full_name: Cataract-1K: Large-Scale Cataract Surgery Video Dataset
datasets.description: 1000 cataract surgery videos from multiple surgeons annotated for 10 surgical phases, instrument segmentation, and tool presence detection. First large-scale cataract surgical video dataset.
datasets.citation: Ghamsarian N et al., 'Cataract-1K: Cataract Surgery Dataset for Domain Generalization of Surgical Workflow Analysis', IEEE TMI 2024. https://github.com/Negin-Ghamsarian/Cataract-1K
datasets.notes: Data hosted on Synapse (free registration required). Install synapseclient: pip install synapseclient. Then: synapse get syn53404917

datasets.name: cataract_101
datasets.full_name: Cataract-101: 101 Cataract Surgery Videos with Phase Annotations
datasets.description: 101 cataract surgery videos with 10-phase workflow annotations. Canonical older cataract benchmark.
datasets.citation: Schoeffmann K, Taschwer M, Sarny S, Munzer B, Primus MJ, Putzgruber D, 'Cataract-101 — video dataset of 101 cataract surgeries', ACM MMSys 2018.
datasets.notes: ITEC public FTP; license verify against institutional page.

datasets.name: cataract_lmm
datasets.full_name: Cataract-LMM: Large-Scale Multi-Source Multi-Task Cataract Surgery Benchmark
datasets.description: 3,000 cataract surgery procedures, 1,134.2 hours of video with phase annotations, instance segmentation, tracking, and skill scoring. Largest public cataract-surgery-video resource.
datasets.citation: Ahmadi MJ, Gandomi I, Abdi P, et al., 'Cataract-LMM: Large-scale multi-source multi-task benchmark for deep learning in surgical video analysis', Scientific Data 2026. doi:10.1038/s41597-026-07464-0
datasets.notes: Largest public cataract-surgery-video resource by hours. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 — non-commercial + no derivatives on HF.

datasets.name: cataracts2017
datasets.description: 50 cataract surgery videos (>9 hours total) with frame-level annotations of 21 surgical tools. Earlier and larger sibling to Cataract-1K.
datasets.citation: Al Hajj et al., 'CATARACTS: Challenge on Automatic Tool Annotation for cataRACT Surgery', Medical Image Analysis 2019.
datasets.notes: IEEE DataPort free account login required.

datasets.name: cavri
datasets.full_name: CAVRI: Computer Analysis of VitreoRetinal Interface Dataset
datasets.description: 50 annotated 3D SD-OCT volumes (7,050 B-scans, 640×385 px) from subjects with vitreomacular adhesion (VMA, 25 eyes) and vitreomacular traction (VMT, 25 eyes). Each volume: 141 B-scans over 2×7×7 mm. Annotated boundaries: PCV, ILM, RPE. Device: Optovue Avanti RTvue.
datasets.citation: Stankiewicz A et al., 'Segmentation of Preretinal Space in Optical Coherence Tomography Images Using Deep Neural Networks', Sensors 21(22):7521 (2021). doi:10.3390/s21227521
datasets.notes: Access by email request: agnieszka.stankiewicz@put.poznan.pl or tomasz.marciniak@put.poznan.pl. Dataset page: https://dsp.put.poznan.pl/cavri_database-191/ GitHub (segmentation code): https://github.com/krzyk87/pcv_segmentation

datasets.name: chaksu
datasets.description: 1,345 fundus images captured across multiple camera manufacturers with OD/OC segmentation + glaucoma classification labels.
datasets.citation: Kumar et al., 'CHAKSU: A glaucoma-specific fundus image database', Scientific Data 2023.

datasets.name: chase_db1
datasets.full_name: CHASE_DB1: Child Heart and Health Study in England
datasets.description: 28 fundus images with manual vessel segmentations (two annotators).
datasets.citation: Owen et al., 'Measuring retinal vessel tortuosity in 10-year-old children: validation of the computer-assisted image analysis of the retina (CAIAR) program', Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 2009. Data: https://researchinnovation.kingston.ac.uk/en/datasets/chasedb1-retinal-vessel-reference-dataset-4/; CHASE-AV reference: https://researchinnovation.kingston.ac.uk/en/datasets/chase-av-retinal-vessel-reference-dataset/
datasets.notes: Manual access only. Kingston landing pages: CHASE_DB1: https://researchinnovation.kingston.ac.uk/en/datasets/chasedb1-retinal-vessel-reference-dataset-4/; CHASE-AV: https://researchinnovation.kingston.ac.uk/en/datasets/chase-av-retinal-vessel-reference-dataset/

datasets.name: chronic_corneal_disorders
datasets.description: Prospective tabular clinical dataset of 332 patients with chronic corneal disorders, including visual acuity, slit-lamp findings, comorbidities, diagnoses, treatments, and risk factors.
datasets.citation: Kusumesh R, Sinha BP, Anand A, Kumar A. Epidemiological and Clinical Profile of Chronic Corneal Disorders: Insights from a Tertiary Care Hospital in Eastern India. Mendeley Data, V1, 2025. doi:10.17632/mcwv6thk8m.1

datasets.name: coph100
datasets.full_name: COph100: Comprehensive Infant Fundus Image Registration Dataset (RIDIRP)
datasets.description: 100 infant eyes with 491 image pairs annotated with ground-truth control points and vessel masks. Enables pediatric / ROP-relevant fundus registration research.
datasets.citation: Hu Y, et al., 'COph100: A comprehensive fundus image registration dataset from infants constituting the RIDIRP database', Scientific Data 2025;12:99.
datasets.notes: Adds infant fundus registration; complements ROP classification datasets.

datasets.name: corn1500
datasets.description: 1,500 in-vivo confocal microscopy images of corneal subbasal nerve plexus, graded for tortuosity (4 levels). Train: 1,200 / Test: 300. 384×384 px, 400×400 µm FOV.
datasets.license: Restricted — request access from record owner
datasets.source_terms: Restricted — request access from record owner
datasets.citation: Mou et al., 'DeepGrading: Deep Learning Grading of Corneal Nerve Tortuosity', IEEE TMI 2022. DOI: 10.1109/TMI.2022.3156906
datasets.notes:
Access is restricted. Request access at:
  https://zenodo.org/records/5880419
After approval, download and extract to the corn1500/ directory.
The CORN database website: https://imed.nimte.ac.cn/CORN.html

datasets.name: corn_collection
datasets.full_name: CORN: Corneal Confocal Microscope Dataset Collection
datasets.description: Combined corneal confocal microscopy collection comprising CORN-1, CORN-2, CORN-3, CORN-1500, CORN-Pro, and CORN-Complex. The subsets support corneal-nerve and cell segmentation, image enhancement, tortuosity grading, and multi-disease analysis.
datasets.citation: iMED. CORN: corneal confocal microscope dataset. Zenodo, Version v2, 2026. doi:10.5281/zenodo.19689814
datasets.notes: The Zenodo record is publicly visible, but its files require a logged-in access request containing the user's name, organization, work, and intended use. EyeDataHub displays those instructions and does not submit the request. This collection includes and overlaps the separately indexed CORN-1500 and CORN-Pro records; its six subsets must not be counted as independent cohorts.

datasets.name: corn_pro
datasets.full_name: CORN Pro: Corneal Nerve Confocal Microscopy Dataset
datasets.description: 1,120 in-vivo confocal microscopy images with pixel-level annotations for corneal subbasal nerves and corneal cells. The source describes 560 images with nerves and Langerhans cells and 560 images with nerves and/or stromal cells.
datasets.citation: CORN database (https://imed.nimte.ac.cn/CORN.html). Zenodo record 14263883: https://zenodo.org/records/14263883
datasets.notes:
Restricted access. Steps to obtain:
  1. Create a free account at https://zenodo.org
  2. Visit https://zenodo.org/records/14263883
  3. Click 'Request access' with affiliation & purpose
Full CORN database: https://imed.nimte.ac.cn/CORN.html

datasets.name: corneal_curvature_fundus
datasets.full_name: Corneal Curvature Prediction Using Fundus Photography
datasets.description: Fundus photographs grouped for corneal curvature prediction, with 50 images per group.
datasets.citation: Corneal curvature prediction using fundus photography dataset. Mendeley Data, V1, 2022. doi:10.17632/bc2jfr7dv9.1

datasets.name: corneal_epithelium_confocal
datasets.full_name: Keratoconus Corneal Epithelium Confocal Fluorescence Dataset
datasets.description: Small corneal confocal fluorescence imaging dataset for keratoconus epithelium analysis.
datasets.citation: Keratoconus corneal epithelium confocal fluorescence dataset. Mendeley Data, V2, 2025. doi:10.17632/n3gky25brh.2

datasets.name: corneal_parameters_kc
datasets.description: Tabular keratoconus dataset with 77 eye-level rows and 60 variables describing visual acuity, contrast sensitivity, stage, and corneal elevation/shape parameters.
datasets.citation: Luguzis A, Liduma S. corneal-parameters-KC-study_2020-07-03. Mendeley Data, V1, 2020. doi:10.17632/3nz4fkwn3y.1

datasets.name: corneal_tomography_iol
datasets.full_name: Multi-Parameter Corneal Tomography Dataset for IOL Selection
datasets.description: Pentacam-derived corneal tomography variables for intraocular-lens and corneal subtype modeling.
datasets.citation: Multi-parameter corneal tomography dataset for IOL selection. Mendeley Data, V1, 2025. doi:10.17632/wddj7bh9p9.1

datasets.name: cornorb
datasets.full_name: CornOrb: Orbscan Corneal Topography and Clinical Annotations
datasets.description: Orbscan corneal topography maps and structured clinical annotations for keratoconus detection.
datasets.citation: CornOrb: A Multimodal Dataset of Orbscan Corneal Topography and Clinical Annotations for Keratoconus Detection. Zenodo, 2026. doi:10.5281/zenodo.20542091

datasets.name: csc_fundus_segmentation
datasets.full_name: Central Serous Chorioretinopathy Fundus Segmentation Dataset
datasets.description: Fundus photographs and segmentation masks for subretinal fluid in central serous chorioretinopathy, with healthy-eye classification controls.
datasets.citation: Yang HK et al. Data for deep-learning-based segmentation of central serous chorioretinopathy in fundus photographs. Mendeley Data, V5, 2022. doi:10.17632/4k64fwnp4k.5

datasets.name: csdi
datasets.full_name: CSDI: Cataract Severity Diagnostic Image Dataset
datasets.description: 187 cataract cases with color fundus images and paired professional cataract-grading diagnostic reports. Designed for medical multimodal-LLM evaluation.
datasets.notes: First public fundus dataset with paired professional cataract reports. Canonical Hugging Face repository: RainyNight/CSDI.

datasets.name: data_oct_fundus_glaucoma
datasets.full_name: Data on OCT and Fundus Images
datasets.description: Fifty OCT and fundus images with healthy/glaucomatous labels and cup-to-disc ratio annotations by ophthalmologists.
datasets.citation: Raja H, Akram MU, Ramzan A, Khalil T, Nazid N. Data on OCT and Fundus Images. Mendeley Data, V2, 2020. doi:10.17632/2rnnz5nz74.2

datasets.name: ddr
datasets.description: 12522 fundus images with DR grading (0-5) and lesion-level segmentation annotations.
datasets.citation: Li et al., 'Diagnostic Assessment of Deep Learning Algorithms for Diabetic Retinopathy Screening', Information Sciences 2019. Data: https://github.com/nkicsl/DDR-dataset — GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1z6tSFmxW_aNayUqVxx6h6bY4kwGzUTEC

datasets.name: deepdrid
datasets.full_name: DeepDRiD: Diabetic Retinopathy Grading and Image Quality Dataset
datasets.description: 2,000 regular fundus images (500 patients × 2 fields × 2 eyes) plus 256 ultra-widefield fundus images labeled for DR severity (ICDR grades 0-4) and image quality assessment (gradable/ungradable). From the DeepDRiD challenge (MICCAI 2020 / ISBI 2020).
datasets.citation: Liu R et al., 'DeepDRiD: Diabetic Retinopathy—Grading and Image Quality Estimation Challenge', Patterns 2022. Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/8248825
datasets.notes: Contains both regular fundus (2000 images in dual-field pairs) and ultra-widefield fundus (256 images). Labels CSV includes DR grade (0-4) and quality score.

datasets.name: deepeyenet
datasets.description: 15,709 fundus images with paired medical reports and extracted keywords. Only public fundus report-generation dataset — useful for VLM / captioning evaluation.
datasets.citation: Huang et al., 'DeepOpht: Medical Report Generation for Retinal Images via Deep Models and Visual Explanation', WACV 2021.
datasets.notes: NDA gated — email deepeyenet.den@gmail.com to request. No automated mirror exists.

datasets.name: dme_vqa
datasets.full_name: Diabetic Macular Edema Visual Question Answering Dataset
datasets.description: Fundus-image VQA dataset for diabetic macular edema derived from IDRiD and e-ophtha.
datasets.citation: Diabetic Macular Edema Visual Question Answering Dataset. Zenodo, 2022. doi:10.5281/zenodo.6784358
datasets.notes: Derivative VQA layer built from existing fundus datasets.

datasets.name: dme_vqa_logical
datasets.full_name: DME VQA Dataset with Logical Relations
datasets.description: Extension of the DME VQA dataset with logical-relation consistency annotations.
datasets.citation: DME VQA dataset with logical relations. Zenodo, 2023. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7777849
datasets.notes: Derivative extension of DME VQA; not an independent image cohort.

datasets.name: dr_arranged
datasets.description: 35,126 fundus images organised for 5-class DR severity grading (ICDR grades 0-4): No DR 25,810 / Mild 2,443 / Moderate 5,292 / Severe 873 / Proliferative 708. Hosted on Alibaba Tianchi.
datasets.citation: Diabetic Retinopathy Arranged Dataset. Tianchi Open Datasets, dataset ID 93926. https://tianchi.aliyun.com/dataset/93926
datasets.notes:
OVERLAP: This is the EyePACS Kaggle 2015 competition TRAIN split (35,126 images) mirrored on Tianchi. Same content as `bidr` (Kaggle mirror) and a strict subset of `eyepacs` (full 88,702). Kept for users who specifically reference the Tianchi 93926 mirror.
Requires free registration at https://tianchi.aliyun.com. Log in → Datasets → 93926 → Download.

datasets.name: drac22
datasets.description: 174 OCTA images for DR lesion segmentation (IRMA, NPA, NV), image quality assessment, and DR grading (3-class).
datasets.citation: Qin et al., 'DRAC: Diabetic Retinopathy Analysis Challenge with Ultra-Wide Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography Images', Medical Image Analysis 2024.
datasets.notes: Available from Grand Challenge after free registration.

datasets.name: dridb
datasets.description: Fifty color fundus images with expert markings of diabetic retinopathy lesions, blood vessels, optic disc, and macula.
datasets.license: Research only: free for research and educational purposes; copying, redistribution, and unauthorized commercial use prohibited
datasets.source_terms: Research only: free for research and educational purposes; copying, redistribution, and unauthorized commercial use prohibited
datasets.citation: Prentasic P, Loncaric S, Vatavuk Z, et al. Diabetic retinopathy image database (DRiDB): A new database for diabetic retinopathy screening programs research. ISPA. 2013:704-709. doi:10.1109/ISPA.2013.6703830
datasets.notes: Access is requested by email from the official University of Zagreb page. The page requires citation of the listed paper when results use the dataset.

datasets.name: drions_db
datasets.full_name: DRIONS-DB: Digital Retinal Images for Optic Nerve Segmentation
datasets.description: 110 color fundus images with optic-disc contour annotations by two experts. Foundational OD-segmentation dataset.
datasets.citation: Carmona et al., 'Identification of the Optic Nerve Head with Genetic Algorithms', Artificial Intelligence in Medicine 2008.
datasets.notes: UNED host serves an expired SSL certificate as of 2026-07. EyeDataHub falls back to an unverified HTTPS request; set PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY=0 in your environment if requests still fails cert validation. Distributed as .rar — needs `unrar` (Linux: `apt install unrar`; macOS: `brew install rar`; Windows: 7-Zip).

datasets.name: drishti_gs
datasets.full_name: DRISHTI-GS: Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation
datasets.description: 101 fundus images annotated for optic disc and cup segmentation by 4 clinicians. Train/test: 50/51.
datasets.citation: Sivaswamy et al., 'Drishti-GS: Retinal image dataset for optic nerve head (ONH) segmentation', ISBI 2014.

datasets.name: drive
datasets.full_name: DRIVE: Digital Retinal Images for Vessel Extraction
datasets.description: Forty color fundus photographs from a diabetic retinopathy screening program, divided into 20 training and 20 test images, with vessel reference annotations and field of view masks.
datasets.license: Unknown; no named dataset license on the official page
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; no named dataset license on the official page
datasets.citation: Staal J, Abramoff MD, Niemeijer M, Viergever MA, van Ginneken B. Ridge-based vessel segmentation in color images of the retina. IEEE Trans Med Imaging. 2004;23:501-509. doi:10.1109/TMI.2004.825627
datasets.notes: The official page reports 768 by 584 pixel images, one manual vessel segmentation for each training image, and hidden test references used by the evaluation server. Verify reuse terms with the source before redistribution.

datasets.name: drtid
datasets.full_name: DRTiD: Diabetic Retinopathy Two-field Image Dataset
datasets.description: 3,100 paired two-field fundus images with DR grading labels. Only public two-field paired DR benchmark.
datasets.citation: Hou et al., 'Cross-Field Transformer for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading on Two-field Fundus Images', IEEE BIBM 2022. arXiv:2211.14552
datasets.notes: Wenjuanxing application form — no auto path.

datasets.name: dryad_aoslo_rpe
datasets.full_name: AOSLO RPE Cell Morphometry and Cone Mosaic Dataset
datasets.description: Adaptive-optics scanning-light-ophthalmoscopy montages and regions of interest for RPE morphometry and cone-to-RPE analysis.
datasets.citation: Human retinal pigment epithelium: in vivo cell morphometry, multispectral autofluorescence, and relationship to cone mosaic. Dryad. 2019. doi:10.5061/dryad.b41j15h
datasets.notes: Contains one-eye data from 10 normal participants for short-wave autofluorescence and photoreceptor reflectance; infrared autofluorescence is available for seven participants with overlap.

datasets.name: dryad_cornea_oct_pentacam
datasets.full_name: Corneal OCT and Pentacam Tomography Dataset
datasets.description: Right-eye corneal OCT and rotating Scheimpflug tomography data with MATLAB code for automatic corneal-layer segmentation.
datasets.citation: Ran Z. Dataset for RSOS-211108. Dryad. 2021. doi:10.5061/dryad.tht76hf0c
datasets.notes: The source describes right-eye OCT and OCULUS Pentacam tomography plus custom segmentation code but does not expose a reliable record count in the repository metadata. Dryad declines whole-version archive assembly for this record; EyeDataHub therefore directs users to the official landing page. Authenticated per-file API transfer is available when a user configures DRYAD_TOKEN.

datasets.name: dryad_functional_oct_alzheimer
datasets.description: Repeated light/dark SD-OCT acquisitions and retinal reflectivity profiles from healthy, neuromyelitis-optica, and Alzheimer groups.
datasets.citation: Bissig D, Zhou C, Le V, Bernard J. A practical approach to functional optical coherence tomography shows abnormal retinal responses in Alzheimer's disease. Dryad. 2020. doi:10.5061/dryad.msbcc2ftc
datasets.notes: The release contains repeated acquisitions across four experiments; source groups include eight young adults, three participants with aquaporin-4 antibodies, 14 early-onset Alzheimer patients, and 14 age-matched controls. Group overlap is not assumed in num_samples. Dryad declines whole-version archive assembly for this record; EyeDataHub therefore directs users to the official landing page. Authenticated per-file API transfer is available when a user configures DRYAD_TOKEN.

datasets.name: dryad_gcc_glaucoma
datasets.full_name: Glaucoma Ganglion Cell Complex Clinical Dataset
datasets.description: Eye-level demographics, clinical measurements, and SD-OCT-derived macular ganglion-cell-complex thickness for glaucoma assessment.
datasets.citation: Poudel A, Gautam Adhikari P, Ghimire B, Thapa M. Diagnostic capability of ganglion cell complex thickness via spectral domain optical coherence tomography in glaucoma. Dryad. 2026. doi:10.5061/dryad.xwdbrv1tn
datasets.notes: Contains 406 eye-level rows from 203 participants (POAG, glaucoma suspect, and control). Both eyes can occur, so analyses must account for within-participant correlation.

datasets.name: dryad_glaucoma_rnfl_vf
datasets.full_name: RNFL and Visual-Field Glaucoma Diagnosis Dataset
datasets.description: Clinical records combining retinal nerve fiber layer, visual-field, corneal-thickness, and intraocular-pressure features.
datasets.citation: Development of machine learning models for diagnosis of glaucoma. Dryad. 2018. doi:10.5061/dryad.q6ft5
datasets.notes: The source reports 399 training/validation cases and 100 held-out test cases. The archive contains examination-record features rather than raw OCT or visual-field images.

datasets.name: dryad_namd_oct_quant
datasets.full_name: Moorfields nAMD Quantitative OCT Biomarker Dataset
datasets.description: Anonymized clinical metadata and automated 3D OCT segmentation volumes for neovascular age-related macular degeneration.
datasets.citation: Moraes G, Fu DJ, Wilson M, et al. Quantitative analysis of optical coherence tomography for neovascular age-related macular degeneration using deep learning. Dryad. 2020. doi:10.5061/dryad.2rbnzs7m4
datasets.notes: Contains derived OCT feature volumes and metadata for 2,473 first-treated and 493 second-treated eyes. Raw OCT scans are not part of this Dryad release.

datasets.name: dryad_namd_visual_prediction
datasets.description: Longitudinal quantitative OCT biomarkers and treatment-response variables for predicting visual acuity in neovascular AMD.
datasets.citation: Predicting incremental and future visual change in neovascular age-related macular degeneration using deep learning. Dryad. 2021. doi:10.5061/dryad.573n5tb5d
datasets.notes: Primary analyses used 926 treatment-naive first-treated eyes from a larger Moorfields cohort. This resource overlaps the Moorfields AMD source cohort but exposes a distinct longitudinal prediction task.

datasets.name: dryad_retinal_vein_cannulation
datasets.full_name: Autonomous Retinal Vein Cannulation Data and Code
datasets.description: Surgical-microscope and intraoperative-OCT data for autonomous robotic retinal-vein cannulation in ex vivo porcine eyes.
datasets.citation: Zhang P, Gehlbach P, Taylor R, Iordachita I, Kobilarov M. Data and code from: Deep learning-based autonomous retinal vein cannulation in ex vivo porcine eyes. Dryad. 2025. doi:10.5061/dryad.3ffbg79zd
datasets.notes: Experiments used 20 static and six motion-simulated ex vivo porcine eyes. The large release contains model-training data and code.

datasets.name: dryad_subretinal_robot
datasets.description: OCT screen recordings, annotated frames, and pressure data from robot-assisted subretinal injections in ex vivo porcine eyes.
datasets.citation: Data and code from: Head-mounted surgical robots are an enabling technology for subretinal injections. Dryad. 2025. doi:10.5061/dryad.w0vt4b91w
datasets.notes: All images and videos are from ex vivo porcine eyes. The repository also includes MATLAB bleb masks and pressure-sensor measurements.

datasets.name: dryad_uveal_melanoma_coog2
datasets.description: Multicenter uveal-melanoma gene-expression, PRAME, clinical, and metastasis-free-survival data for prognostic modeling.
datasets.citation: 15-gene expression profile and PRAME as an integrated prognostic test for uveal melanoma: First report of Collaborative Ocular Oncology Group Study No. 2 (COOG2.1). Dryad. 2025. doi:10.5061/dryad.n8pk0p340
datasets.notes: Contains 1,577 subjects enrolled across 26 centers with a 15-gene expression profile, PRAME status, clinical variables, and follow-up.

datasets.name: duke_amd_chiu
datasets.full_name: Duke AMD Pathology OCT Segmentation Dataset
datasets.description: Twenty OCT volumes with 220 selected B-scans from eyes with non-neovascular AMD, drusen, and geographic atrophy, including manual and automated pathology markings.
datasets.license: Unknown; no named dataset license on the official page
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; no named dataset license on the official page
datasets.citation: Chiu SJ, Izatt JA, O'Connell RV, Winter KP, Toth CA, Farsiu S. Validated automatic segmentation of AMD pathology including drusen and geographic atrophy in SD-OCT images. Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci. 2012;53:53-61. doi:10.1167/iovs.11-7640
datasets.notes: The sample count is the 20-eye main validation cohort. The archive also contains ten reproducibility volumes acquired at 0 and 90 degrees and MATLAB display scripts. The source page does not state a named reuse license.

datasets.name: duke_chiu_boe
datasets.description: 110 OCT B-scans from 10 DME subjects with 8 layer boundaries and fluid region annotations by 2 clinicians.
datasets.citation: Chiu et al., 'Kernel regression based segmentation of optical coherence tomography images with diabetic macular edema', Biomedical Optics Express 2014. DOI: 10.1364/BOE.6.001172

datasets.name: duke_rpedc
datasets.description: OCT data from 384 subjects, including 269 with AMD and 115 normal subjects, with 38,400 B-scans and derived total retina and RPE-drusen complex thickness measurements.
datasets.license: Research only: research and educational use; commercialization and redistribution prohibited
datasets.source_terms: Research only: research and educational use; commercialization and redistribution prohibited
datasets.citation: Farsiu S, Chiu SJ, O'Connell RV, et al. Quantitative classification of eyes with and without intermediate age-related macular degeneration using optical coherence tomography. Ophthalmology. 2014;121:162-172. doi:10.1016/j.ophtha.2013.07.013
datasets.notes: The source describes more than 20 GB of subject data, segmentation boundaries, and thickness maps.

datasets.name: e_ophtha
datasets.full_name: E-ophtha (EX + MA): Exudate and Microaneurysm Segmentation
datasets.description: 463 color fundus images with pixel-level segmentation: 82 with exudate (EX) + 381 with microaneurysm (MA) annotations. Standard DR lesion-segmentation benchmark.
datasets.citation: Decencière et al., 'TeleOphta: Machine Learning and Image Processing Methods for Teleophthalmology', IRBM 2013.
datasets.notes: Official source (ADCIS) requires a request form. EyeDataHub uses the Kaggle community mirror. Verify license terms with the original ADCIS distribution before commercial use.

datasets.name: eed_astig
datasets.description: Pediatric external-eye photographs with gaze-view annotations, corneal masks, eyelid/eyelash-line keypoints, and clinical tabular parameters for astigmatism-related research.
datasets.license: Data Use Agreement; non-commercial research only
datasets.source_terms: Data Use Agreement; non-commercial research only
datasets.citation: Liu H, Lv Y, Li S, Liu R, Hou X, Chen F, Liu Y, You J, Wang H, Liu S. EED-Astig. Zenodo, 2026. doi:10.5281/zenodo.18976824
datasets.notes: Zenodo record describes 640 children aged 3-6 years with 3,088 external-eye image files, JSON annotations, masks/keypoints, and Parameter.xls. Access requires explicit agreement to a data-use agreement and is non-commercial research only.

datasets.name: erdes
datasets.full_name: ERDES: Ocular Ultrasound Video Benchmark (Retinal Detachment + Macula)
datasets.description: 5,381 B-scan ocular ultrasound video clips with retinal-detachment presence and macula-on/off status labels. Total runtime approximately 5 hours 10 minutes. Only public ocular ultrasound video benchmark.
datasets.citation: Ozkut Y, Navard P, Adhikari S, et al., 'ERDES: A benchmark video dataset for retinal detachment and macular status classification in ocular ultrasound', arXiv 2503.04525, 2025.
datasets.notes: Adds ocular ultrasound video — modality EyeDataHub otherwise lacks. Project page at github/arxiv referenced. Access verified via project site.

datasets.name: eth_xgaze
datasets.description: High-resolution multi-camera face images with calibrated gaze targets, extreme head poses, and varied illumination.
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with additional dataset conditions
datasets.source_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with additional dataset conditions
datasets.citation: Zhang X, Park S, Beeler T, Bradley D, Tang S, Hilliges O. ETH-XGaze: A Large Scale Dataset for Gaze Estimation under Extreme Head Pose and Gaze Variation. ECCV. 2020.
datasets.notes: Contains 1,083,492 images from 110 participants. The official page offers approximately 130 GB 224-pixel face patches, 497 GB 448-pixel patches, or about 7 TB of raw images on request. The linked completed license adds conditions to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

datasets.name: external_eye_blepharitis
datasets.full_name: External Eye Photographs for Screening Referable Blepharitis
datasets.description: External eye photographs curated from publicly available web sources for binary classification of referable blepharitis versus normal.
datasets.citation: Yoo T. External Eye Photographs for Screening Referable Blepharitis. Mendeley Data, V1, 2025. doi:10.17632/bp37vw4z8d.1
datasets.notes: Web-sourced external photographs; verify source provenance before clinical validation or redistribution.

datasets.name: eye_conjunctiva_segmentation
datasets.description: Five hundred forty-seven smartphone eye photographs with conjunctiva masks annotated independently by two annotators.
datasets.citation: Rahman MM, Faruk O, Ullah SSA, Alam MJ, Sadman SMS. Eye Conjunctiva Segmentation Dataset. Mendeley Data, V1, 2023. doi:10.17632/yxwjgcndg2.1

datasets.name: eye_disease_image_mendeley
datasets.description: Original and augmented eye-disease image dataset covering retinitis pigmentosa, retinal detachment, pterygium, myopia, macular scar, glaucoma, disc edema, diabetic retinopathy, central serous chorioretinopathy, and healthy classes.
datasets.citation: Eye Disease Image Dataset. Mendeley Data, V1, 2024. doi:10.17632/s9bfhswzjb.1
datasets.notes: Includes augmented images; use original subset for clinical validation.

datasets.name: eyecare_100k
datasets.description: ~102K VQA pairs derived from 58,485 images across 8 ophthalmic modalities (fluorescein angiography, ICGA, OCT, CFP, ultrasound biomicroscopy, slit-lamp, fundus auto-fluorescence, CT) covering 100+ diseases.
datasets.license: Mixed (inherits source-dataset licenses) — needs per-row check
datasets.source_terms: Mixed (inherits source-dataset licenses) — needs per-row check
datasets.citation: EyecareGPT: arXiv 2504.13650; ACM MM 2025. github.com/DCDmllm/EyecareGPT
datasets.notes: Status: PENDING RELEASE. Largest open ophthalmology VQA corpus when published. EyecareGPT models are out (LLSuzy/* on HF) but the VQA dataset itself is not yet public as of 2026-06.

datasets.name: eyecatcher_visual_field
datasets.full_name: Eyecatcher Tablet-Based Visual Field Home-Monitoring Data
datasets.description: Visual-field data from glaucoma home monitoring: mean deviation, duration, and pointwise differential light sensitivity values across HFA and Eyecatcher tests.
datasets.citation: Jones P. Data for glaucoma home-monitoring using a tablet-based visual field test (Eyecatcher). Mendeley Data, V2, 2021. doi:10.17632/swsfj47cxw.2

datasets.name: eyepacs
datasets.description: ~88,000 fundus images graded 0–4 for DR severity. Largest public DR dataset; competition images from EyePACS clinics.
datasets.citation: EyePACS / California Healthcare Foundation. 'Diabetic Retinopathy Detection', Kaggle Competition, 2015.
datasets.notes: Very large (~89 GB). Kaggle competition account and acceptance of rules required.

datasets.name: eyeq
datasets.full_name: EyeQ Retinal Image Quality Assessment Dataset
datasets.description: Quality labels for 28,792 EyePACS fundus images, graded as good, usable, or reject and divided into the original EyePACS train and test partitions.
datasets.license: Unknown for released quality labels; code is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
datasets.source_terms: Unknown for released quality labels; code is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
datasets.citation: Fu H, Wang B, Shen J, et al. Evaluation of retinal image quality assessment networks in different color-spaces. MICCAI. 2019. doi:10.1007/978-3-030-32239-7_6
datasets.notes: EyeQ is a distinct annotation layer over EyePACS. The repository license covers the code but does not clearly license the quality labels. It does not provide the source images. Users must obtain EyePACS separately and comply with its terms.

datasets.name: fairvlmed
datasets.full_name: FairVLMed: Fair Vision-Language Medical Ophthalmic Dataset
datasets.description: 10,000 scanning-laser ophthalmoscopy fundus images paired with de-identified clinical notes, visual-field measurements, glaucoma labels, and demographic attributes.
datasets.citation: Harvard AI Robotics, FairVLMed: Fair vision-language medical ophthalmic dataset. HuggingFace, 2024.
datasets.notes: The official dataset card reports 10,000 patients and 10,000 samples (7,000 train, 1,000 validation, 2,000 test). No source statement supporting cohort identity with the separate Harvard-FairVision record was found, so no catalog relationship is asserted.

datasets.name: fang_sbsdi_oct
datasets.full_name: Duke Fang SBSDI Retinal OCT Dataset
datasets.description: Paired low signal and high signal retinal OCT data used to study sparse acquisition, denoising, interpolation, and reconstruction in normal and non-neovascular AMD eyes.
datasets.citation: Fang L, Li S, McNabb RP, et al. Fast acquisition and reconstruction of optical coherence tomography images via sparse representation. IEEE Trans Med Imaging. 2013;32:2034-2049. doi:10.1109/TMI.2013.2271904
datasets.notes: The count records the 41 human participants described in the paper, not the number of files. The archive is organized by experiment rather than an official train and test split and also includes software and mouse imaging data.

datasets.name: farfum_rop
datasets.full_name: FARFUM-ROP: Fundus Annotation Repository for Retinopathy of Prematurity
datasets.description: Wide-field fundus images from premature infants for ROP staging (Stages 1–5 + Plus Disease). Expert-annotated for AI-assisted ROP diagnosis and screening.
datasets.citation: Riazi-Esfahani H et al., 'FARFUM-RoP: A dataset for machine learning-based plus disease diagnosis in retinopathy of prematurity', Scientific Data 2024. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.c.6721269

datasets.name: ffa_ir
datasets.description: Fundus fluorescein angiography images paired with Chinese and translated English reports for report-generation research.
datasets.citation: FFA-IR: Towards an Explainable and Reliable Medical Report Generation Benchmark. PhysioNet, 2021.

datasets.name: fimd
datasets.description: Seventy retinal image pairs with visible myopia development and manually annotated corresponding control points.
datasets.citation: Wang Z, Zou H, Guo Y, Guo S, Zhao X, Wang Y, Sun M. Fundus Image Myopia Development (FIMD) dataset. Mendeley Data, V1, 2023. doi:10.17632/jkzsh6pcv4.1

datasets.name: fiqs
datasets.full_name: FIQS: Fundus Image Quality Scores Dataset
datasets.description: A set of 2,246 fundus images with continuous mean opinion scores from 0 to 100, three quality grades, and the individual scores of six ophthalmologists.
datasets.citation: Gong Z. FIQS Dataset (Fundus Image Quality Scores). Figshare. 2025. doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.28129847.v1
datasets.notes: The deposit provides original resolution images, standardized 1024 by 1024 versions, aggregate scores, and individual grader scores.

datasets.name: fire
datasets.description: 129 fundus images from 39 patients forming 134 registration pairs with anatomical ground-truth control points. Only public registration benchmark for ophthalmology.
datasets.citation: Hernandez-Matas et al., 'FIRE: Fundus Image Registration Dataset', Journal of Modeling in Ophthalmology 2017.
datasets.notes: Distributed as a 7z archive. EyeDataHub validates archive member paths before extracting it.

datasets.name: fives
datasets.description: 800 high-resolution (2048x2048) fundus images with pixel-wise vessel segmentation. Covers normal, DR, AMD, glaucoma.
datasets.citation: Jin et al., 'FIVES: A Fundus Image Dataset for Artificial Intelligence based Vessel Segmentation', Scientific Data 2022.

datasets.name: fociset_pamm
datasets.description: SD-OCT B-scans with bounding-box and polygon annotations for paracentral acute middle maculopathy lesions.
datasets.citation: FociSet: A dataset for detection and segmentation of paracentral acute middle maculopathy lesions in OCT images. Data in Brief. 2024;57:111121. doi:10.1016/j.dib.2024.111121
datasets.notes: Contains 133 OCT images with PAMM foci annotated in YOLO bounding-box and JSON polygon formats.

datasets.name: fovea
datasets.description: 40 patients with paired pre-operative fundus images and intra-operative biomicroscopy video clips. Annotated for optic disc and vessel segmentation across domains.
datasets.citation: Ravasio et al., 'FOVEA: paired pre- and intra-operative fundus + biomicroscopy', Scientific Data 2025. doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04965-2
datasets.notes: Unique pre-op/intra-op paired modality — only public example.

datasets.name: fprm_retina
datasets.full_name: FPRM Multimodal Eye Imaging and Psychological Assessment Dataset
datasets.description: Fundus photography, multispectral and functional retinal imaging, retinal blood-flow and pupillary-light videos, retina-characteristic labels, quality labels, demographics, and psychological assessments.
datasets.license: Synapse Data Use Agreement; research use only
datasets.source_terms: Synapse Data Use Agreement; research use only
datasets.citation: Zhang G, Qu Y, Zhang Y, et al. Multimodal Eye Imaging, Retina Characteristics, and Psychological Assessment Dataset. Scientific Data. 2024;11:836. doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03690-6
datasets.notes: Scientific Data descriptor reports 3,361 fundus photographs from 1,683 participants plus multimodal imaging from 384 participants; Synapse access requires certified account and completed data-use agreement.

datasets.name: fundus_105k
datasets.description: Fundus-focused text dataset for LLM/RAG workflows.
datasets.citation: PJMixers-Dev/Fundus-105K. Hugging Face dataset, accessed 2026-07.

datasets.name: fundus_avseg
datasets.description: 100 high-resolution color fundus images with pixel-wise artery / vein / crossing labels from a mixed disease cohort.
datasets.citation: Fundus-AVSeg dataset, Figshare project 229986 (2025). Companion paper: Basit & Alam, 'AVSeg-XAI', BioData Mining, doi:10.1186/s13040-026-00573-x (2026). Sci. Data DOI 10.1038/s41597-025-05381-2 was the paper venue at time of indexing — verify at final publication.

datasets.name: fundus_cc_2_5m
datasets.description: Large fundus-related multilingual text corpus for LLM pretraining or retrieval.
datasets.citation: PJMixers-Dev/Fundus-CC-2.5M. Hugging Face dataset, accessed 2026-07.
datasets.notes: Large web/text corpus; verify source filtering and redistribution terms before reuse.

datasets.name: fundus_domain_generalization
datasets.full_name: Fundus Dataset for Domain Generalization in Optic Disc/Cup Segmentation
datasets.description: Five-domain optic disc/cup segmentation benchmark composed from REFUGE, Drishti-GS, ORIGA, RIGA, and related sources.
datasets.citation: A Fundus Image Dataset for Domain Generalization in Joint Segmentation of Optic Disc and Optic Cup. Zenodo, 2023. doi:10.5281/zenodo.8009107
datasets.notes: Composite of datasets already indexed separately; retained as a benchmark split/annotation resource.

datasets.name: fundus_report_dataset
datasets.description: Fundus/UWF image-report dataset derived from DeepDRiD and OUWFD-style resources for report-generation research.
datasets.citation: zzzzineun/fundus-report-dataset. Hugging Face dataset, accessed 2026-07.
datasets.notes: Derivative report-generation view; verify source image terms row by row.

datasets.name: g1020
datasets.description: 1020 fundus images with binary glaucoma labels (697 normal, 323 glaucoma), plus optic disc/cup annotations.
datasets.citation: Bajwa et al., 'G1020: A Benchmark Retinal Fundus Image Dataset for Computer-Aided Glaucoma Detection', arXiv 2020.

datasets.name: gamma
datasets.full_name: GAMMA — Glaucoma Grading from Multi-Modality Images
datasets.description: 300 paired fundus + 3D OCT volumes. Glaucoma grading into Normal / Early / Advanced plus OD/OC segmentation and fovea location.
datasets.citation: Wu J. et al., 'GAMMA Challenge: Glaucoma Grading from Multi-Modality Imaging', MIA 2023.

datasets.name: gaze360
datasets.description: Indoor and outdoor panoramic-camera recordings with continuous three-dimensional gaze labels across wide head poses and distances.
datasets.license: Unknown; registration required and source terms must be checked
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; registration required and source terms must be checked
datasets.citation: Kellnhofer P, Recasens A, Stent S, Matusik W, Torralba A. Gaze360: Physically Unconstrained Gaze Estimation in the Wild. ICCV. 2019:6912-6921. arXiv:1910.10088
datasets.notes: The project reports 238 participants; the benchmark is commonly reported as 172,000 labeled frames. Access uses registration, and the public landing page does not state a standard reuse license.

datasets.name: gaze_capture
datasets.description: Crowdsourced iPhone and iPad face videos with screen-fixation coordinates for appearance-based mobile gaze estimation.
datasets.license: Unknown; registration required and source terms must be checked
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; registration required and source terms must be checked
datasets.citation: Krafka K, Khosla A, Kellnhofer P, et al. Eye Tracking for Everyone. CVPR. 2016:2176-2184. arXiv:1606.05814
datasets.notes: The primary paper reports 2,445,504 frames with fixation locations from 1,474 participants. The official site requires account registration; verify the current agreement before reuse.

datasets.name: ghana_eye_screening
datasets.full_name: Eye Screening Data for First-Year University Students in Ghana
datasets.description: Questionnaire and clinical eye-screening data from first-year university students in Ghana.
datasets.citation: Eye screening data for first year university students in Ghana. Mendeley Data, V4, 2025. doi:10.17632/mfv6sb5wyc.4

datasets.name: glaucoma_eye_movements
datasets.full_name: Eye Movements of Glaucoma Patients with Asymmetrical Visual Field Loss
datasets.description: Raw and processed eye-tracking data from glaucoma patients with asymmetrical visual-field loss during free viewing.
datasets.citation: Data on eye movements of glaucoma patients with asymmetrical visual field loss during free viewing. Zenodo, 2023. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7761477

datasets.name: goals
datasets.description: 300 circumpapillary OCT images. RNFL/GCIPL/choroid layer segmentation plus binary glaucoma classification.

datasets.notes: Primary challenge page: https://aistudio.baidu.com/competition/detail/783/0/introduction. Automated downloader still tries the known Google Drive mirror (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1P1cLm9_Pwq4fum4lB1-LGUayO-NMvF5I/view) and then Zenodo record 6362363.

datasets.name: goblet_cell_segmentation
datasets.full_name: Human Conjunctival Goblet Cell Segmentation Dataset
datasets.description: Phase-contrast microscopy fields of cultured human conjunctival goblet cells with semantic and instance-compatible masks.
datasets.citation: Fineide FA, Bair J, Utheim TP, Riegler MA, Dartt DA. Development of Human Conjunctival Goblet Cell Segmentation Datasets to Improve Quantitation. Scientific Data. 2026. doi:10.1038/s41597-026-07309-w
datasets.notes: The independent unit is 24 unpatched 2048x1536 fields with 65,108 cell instances. The release also contains 1,152 derivative 256x256 patches (75,597 counted instances because boundary cells can recur).

datasets.name: grape
datasets.full_name: GRAPE: Glaucoma Real-world Appraisal Progression Ensemble
datasets.description: 263 eyes × 1,115 visits. Multi-modal: VF (HFA 24-2), fundus photographs, OCT RNFL, IOP, CCT. Labels: VF progression, OD segmentation, glaucoma stage.
datasets.citation: Wen et al., 'GRAPE: A multi-modal dataset for glaucoma progression ',Figshare collection 2022.
datasets.notes: Multi-modal: contains fundus images, VF data, OCT measurements, and clinical metadata. Requires manual download from Figshare.

datasets.name: harvard_fairvision
datasets.full_name: Harvard-FairVision (AMD + DR + Glaucoma, paired SLO + OCT)
datasets.description: 30,000 subjects (10K each AMD, DR, glaucoma) with paired SLO fundus and OCT B-scans, demographic attributes (race, ethnicity, gender, language), for fairness analysis.
datasets.citation: Luo et al., 'FairVision: Equitable Deep Learning for Eye Disease Screening via Fair Identity Scaling', arXiv 2310.02492; Harvard Ophthalmology AI Lab 2024. Three disease sub-repos: Harvard-AMD, Harvard-DR, Harvard-Glaucoma. 30,000 subjects total (10K each).
datasets.notes: Application-gated (Harvard form). No automated mirror. Sub-repos: github.com/Harvard-Ophthalmology-AI-Lab/Harvard-{AMD,DR,Glaucoma}.

datasets.name: harvard_gdp
datasets.full_name: Harvard GDP: Glaucoma Detection and Progression Dataset
datasets.description: 1,000 patients with OCT RNFLT maps (225×225), visual field measurements, and demographics for glaucoma detection (binary) and longitudinal progression forecasting (6 definitions). First public glaucoma progression dataset from Harvard Ophthalmology AI Lab.
datasets.citation: Luo Z et al., 'Glaucoma Progression Prediction Using Retinal Thickness via Deep Learning', arXiv 2308.13411, 2023. https://github.com/Harvard-Ophthalmology-AI-Lab/Harvard-GDP

datasets.name: harvard_glaucoma
datasets.description: Fundus images for glaucoma detection from Harvard Medical School / Mass Eye and Ear. Binary glaucoma classification.
datasets.citation: Luo X. et al., 'Harvard Glaucoma Detection and Progression Dataset', Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/1YRRAC, 2023.

datasets.name: hassan_composite_retina
datasets.full_name: Composite Retinal Fundus and OCT Dataset with Clinical Markings
datasets.description: Composite fundus and OCT dataset with retinal layer, retinal lesion, and macular/glaucomatous disorder markings.
datasets.citation: Hassan T, Akram MU, Nazir MN. A Composite Retinal Fundus and OCT Dataset with Detailed Clinical Markings. Mendeley Data, V4, 2021. doi:10.17632/trghs22fpg.4
datasets.notes: Composite dataset; verify component provenance before treating as an independent cohort.

datasets.name: hei_med
datasets.full_name: HEI-MED: Hamilton Eye Institute Macular Edema Dataset
datasets.description: A collection of 169 fundus photographs with expert exudate and bright lesion annotations, clinical metadata, optic nerve locations, vessel estimates, and image quality scores.
datasets.citation: Giancardo L, Meriaudeau F, Karnowski TP, et al. Exudate-based diabetic macular edema detection in fundus images using publicly available datasets. Med Image Anal. 2012;16:216-226. doi:10.1016/j.media.2011.07.004
datasets.notes: The source README permits only non-commercial research use and requires citation. No SPDX license file is present.

datasets.name: hpmi
datasets.description: 4,011 color fundus images labeled for high-myopia vs pathological-myopia classification — largest public dataset for HM/PM separation.
datasets.citation: Huang et al., 'HPMI: A retinal fundus image dataset for identification of high and pathological myopia based on deep learning', Figshare 2024. doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24800232
datasets.notes: Complements EyeDataHub's PALM (pathological-myopia challenge).

datasets.name: hrf
datasets.description: 45 high-resolution fundus images (healthy/DR/glaucoma) with manual vessel segmentation.
datasets.citation: Budai et al., 'Robust vessel segmentation in fundus images', Intl Journal of Biomedical Imaging 2013.
datasets.notes: Requires manual download from FAU Erlangen-Nuremberg website.

datasets.name: hrf_seg_plus
datasets.description: Extended HRF annotations for optic disc, cup, retinal vessels, and alpha/beta peripapillary zones.
datasets.citation: HRF-Seg+: A multi-structure annotated fundus image dataset. Zenodo, 2026. doi:10.5281/zenodo.16744782
datasets.notes: Derivative annotation layer for existing HRF images.

datasets.name: hyamd
datasets.full_name: HYAMD High-Resolution Fundus Image Dataset for AMD Diagnosis
datasets.description: High-resolution fundus images from Hillel Yaffe Medical Center for age-related macular degeneration diagnosis.
datasets.citation: Meisel M, Cohen BA, Baskin M, Tiosano B, Behar J, Berkowitz E. HYAMD High-Resolution Fundus Image Dataset for AMD Diagnosis. PhysioNet, version 1.0.0, 2025. doi:10.13026/ydf1-z238
datasets.notes: PhysioNet requires registration and the project-specific Restricted Health Data Use Agreement before file access.

datasets.name: hygd
datasets.description: 747 fundus images from 288 patients with glaucoma labels confirmed by paired OCT + visual field. First public dataset with gold-standard multimodal glaucoma confirmation.
datasets.citation: Hillel Yaffe Glaucoma Dataset, PhysioNet 2024 (v1.1.0). Labels gold-standardized via OCT + visual field. doi:10.13026/pdxv-m215
datasets.notes: Open-access (ODC-BY) — no PhysioNet credentialing required.

datasets.name: ichallenge_amd
datasets.description: 400 training fundus images with AMD classification (non-AMD vs AMD) and lesion annotations. Challenge dataset from ISBI 2020.
datasets.citation: Fu et al., 'Age-Related Macular Degeneration and Pathologic Myopia Fundus Image Analysis Challenge', ISBI 2020.
datasets.notes:
Grand Challenge login is required:
  https://amd.grand-challenge.org/download/
The original Baidu BROAD portal has returned intermittent 5xx errors since 2024. Alternative partial resource:
- PaddleSeg optic-disc subset (~19 MB, direct HTTPS, no login): https://paddleseg.bj.bcebos.com/dataset/optic_disc_seg.zip
The full 1.5 GB dataset is only via Grand Challenge or the Baidu portal.

datasets.name: ichallenge_oct
datasets.description: OCT challenge datasets from HDMILab covering retinal layer segmentation and fluid detection tasks from MICCAI/OMIA workshops. Includes sub-challenges such as AMD/CSC/DR classification and retinal layer segmentation; GAMMA challenge provides OCT volumes from 300 glaucoma patients (fundus + 3D OCT).
datasets.citation: HDMILab iChallenge. http://hdmilab.cn/ichallenge
datasets.notes: num_samples refers to patient volumes (GAMMA has 300 patients, each with 3D OCT + fundus). Slice counts depend on sub-challenge. Visit http://hdmilab.cn/ichallenge, register/log in, and download the relevant challenge dataset(s). Place extracted files under ~/.eyedatahub/data/ichallenge_oct/.

datasets.name: idrid
datasets.full_name: IDRiD: Indian Diabetic Retinopathy Image Dataset
datasets.description: 516 fundus images with DR grade (0-4), macular edema grade (0-2), and pixel-level lesion segmentation for 81 images.
datasets.citation: Porwal et al., 'Indian diabetic retinopathy image dataset (IDRiD): A database for diabetic retinopathy screening research', Data 2018.
datasets.notes: Requires IEEE DataPort account (free).

datasets.name: insegcat
datasets.full_name: InSegCat: Instance Segmentation for Cataract Surgery
datasets.description: Two COCO-format instance-segmentation datasets derived from cataract surgery videos, covering instruments and anatomical structures.
datasets.citation: InSegCat dataset, ITEC AAU. COCO-format instance segmentation for cataract surgery.

datasets.name: intraretinal_cystoid_fluid

datasets.description: OCT images for intraretinal cystoid-fluid segmentation, partly derived from public OCT DME sources with expert-selected masks.
datasets.citation: Intraretinal Cystoid Fluid dataset. Kaggle, accessed 2026-07.
datasets.notes: Partly derived from existing OCT datasets; retain as segmentation-mask resource.

datasets.name: irfdrd
datasets.full_name: Iraqi Retinal Fundus Diabetic Retinopathy Dataset
datasets.description: Retinal fundus dataset for five-class diabetic-retinopathy grading.
datasets.citation: Iraqi Retinal Fundus Diabetic Retinopathy Dataset. Zenodo, 2024. doi:10.5281/zenodo.12552326

datasets.name: jichi
datasets.full_name: Jichi Medical University Diabetic Retinopathy Dataset
datasets.description: 9,939 color fundus images from Japanese patients with DR grading labels (Davis grading scale).
datasets.citation: Takahashi et al., 'Applying artificial intelligence to disease staging: Deep learning for improved staging of diabetic retinopathy', PLOS ONE 2017. Article: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5480986/

datasets.name: jrc_multimodal_vessels
datasets.description: Multi-modal retinal vessel segmentation dataset spanning fluorescence angiography, fundus autofluorescence, and infrared imaging.
datasets.citation: JRC-Multi-Modal Retinal Vessel Segmentation. Zenodo, 2026. doi:10.5281/zenodo.17874693
datasets.notes: Source page indicates access by academic request; not an open direct download.

datasets.name: jsiec

datasets.source_terms: Other open access (Zenodo; no standard license identifier)
datasets.citation: Cen et al., 'Automatic detection of 39 fundus diseases and conditions in retinal photographs using deep neural networks', Nature Communications 2021. doi:10.1038/s41467-021-25138-w. Data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.3477553
datasets.notes: Zenodo labels the deposit as other open access but does not name a standard reuse license. Verify terms before redistribution.

datasets.name: justraigs
datasets.full_name: JustRAIGS: Just Referral AI Glaucoma Screening Dataset
datasets.description: 101,442 gradable fundus images labeled as referable (RG) or non-referable (NRG) for glaucoma. Image data from EyePACS LLC; labels from Rotterdam Eye Hospital expert graders.
datasets.citation: Thakoor et al., 'JustRAIGS: Justify Your Artificial Intelligence Prediction for Referable or Not Referable Glaucoma Screening', MICCAI 2023. Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/10035093
datasets.notes: Large dataset (~100 GB). The record is publicly accessible but downloading requires accepting the CC BY-NC-ND terms on the Zenodo page. Set ZENODO_TOKEN in .env if access is denied.

datasets.name: keratoconus_detection_kaggle
datasets.description: Corneal map images for three-class keratoconus detection.
datasets.citation: Keratoconus detection dataset. Kaggle, accessed 2026-07.

datasets.name: kermany_oct
datasets.full_name: Kermany OCT 2018: Retinal OCT Image Classification
datasets.description: ~84,000 retinal OCT B-scan images across 4 classes: CNV, DME, DRUSEN, NORMAL. Train: ~83,484 / Test: 1000.
datasets.citation: Kermany et al., 'Identifying medical diagnoses and treatable diseases by image-based deep learning', Cell 2018.

datasets.name: lag
datasets.description: 11,760 fundus images with glaucoma classification labels and ophthalmologist-derived attention maps. Largest public glaucoma dataset with attention ground truth.
datasets.license: Research only (no redistribution; password by email)
datasets.source_terms: Research only (no redistribution; password by email)
datasets.citation: Li et al., 'Attention Based Glaucoma Detection: A Large-scale Database and CNN Model', CVPR 2019.
datasets.notes: Dropbox link gated by password — email liliu1995@buaa.edu.cn to request access. Cannot be auto-downloaded.

datasets.name: leops_erg
datasets.full_name: LEOPs Light-Adapted Electroretinogram and Oscillatory Potentials Dataset
datasets.description: Light-adapted electroretinogram and oscillatory-potential waveform dataset from 253 pediatric participants, with structured JSON, tabular metadata, and electrode-position eye images.
datasets.citation: Constable P, Thompson D, Lee I, Loh L, Zhdanov A, Kulyabin M, Maier A. Light-Adapted Electroretinogram and Oscillatory Potentials (LEOPs) Dataset for Autism Spectrum Disorder and Typically Developing Individuals. Mendeley Data, V1, 2026. doi:10.17632/w3yx7hdds7.1
datasets.notes: Source reports 5,309 averaged ERG waveforms, 4,434 OP waveforms, 253 participant JSON files, and 558 electrode-position eye images.

datasets.name: lmod_cataract_1k
datasets.description: Processed Cataract-1K surgical-frame dataset for segmentation/object-detection workflows.
datasets.citation: mehti/LMOD-Cataract-1K. Hugging Face dataset, accessed 2026-07.
datasets.notes: Derivative/processed view of existing Cataract-1K.

datasets.name: lmod_cataract_1k_cot
datasets.description: Synthetic surgical-analysis instruction/chain-of-thought dataset derived from Cataract-1K frames.
datasets.citation: mehti/LMOD-Cataract-1K-surgical-analysis-cot. Hugging Face dataset, accessed 2026-07.
datasets.notes: Synthetic instruction layer derived from Cataract-1K; not an independent clinical dataset.

datasets.name: lmod_plus
datasets.description: Composite multimodal ophthalmology benchmark with multi-granular anatomical, diagnostic, staging, demographic, and text annotations.
datasets.license: Mixed upstream licenses; verify each component
datasets.source_terms: Mixed upstream licenses; verify each component
datasets.citation: Qin Z, Liu Y, Yin Y, et al. LMOD+: A Comprehensive Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Developing and Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Ophthalmology. ACM Transactions on Computing for Healthcare. 2026. doi:10.1145/3801746
datasets.notes: Integrates 32,633 instances from nine public datasets across five modalities and 12 conditions. It adds a distinct benchmark and annotation surface but does not replace the source datasets; license and redistribution terms remain component-specific.

datasets.name: lpw
datasets.full_name: LPW Labelled Pupils in the Wild
datasets.description: High-speed head-mounted eye-region videos with pupil-center annotations under varied indoor, outdoor, eyewear, and lighting conditions.
datasets.citation: Tonsen M, Zhang X, Sugano Y, Bulling A. Labelled Pupils in the Wild: A Dataset for Studying Pupil Detection in Unconstrained Environments. ETRA. 2016:139-142. doi:10.1145/2857491.2857520
datasets.notes: The institutional page reports 66 videos and 130,856 images from 22 participants. It explicitly limits use to non-commercial scientific purposes.

datasets.name: maetschke_glaucoma_oct
datasets.description: A set of 1,110 optic nerve head OCT volumes from 624 patients, including 847 scans with primary open angle glaucoma and 263 healthy scans.
datasets.citation: Maetschke S, Antony B, Ishikawa H, Wollstein G, Schuman J, Garnavi R. A feature agnostic approach for glaucoma detection in OCT volumes. PLoS One. 2019;14:e0219126. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0219126. Data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.1481223
datasets.notes: The paper reports patient-grouped splits of 888 training, 112 validation, and 110 test scans. Volumes are stored as NumPy arrays.

datasets.name: maples_dr
datasets.full_name: MAPLES-DR: Montreal Annotation Project for DR
datasets.description: 198 fundus images (from MESSIDOR) with pixel-wise segmentation for 10 biomarkers (lesions + structures) + DR and ME severity grades.
datasets.citation: Morin et al., 'MAPLES-DR: MESSIDOR Annotation Project for Lesion and Structures Evaluation in Diabetic Retinopathy', Scientific Data 2024.
datasets.notes: Segmentation maps for 10 retinal biomarkers.

datasets.name: mario
datasets.description: ~30,000 longitudinal OCT B-scans across multiple patient visits, annotated for AMD change detection and progression monitoring.
datasets.citation: Quellec G, Zeghlache R, et al., 'MARIO: Monitoring AMD Progression from OCT — MICCAI 2024 Challenge', arXiv 2506.02976. Data: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.15270469 (2025). Peer-reviewed proceedings pending.
datasets.notes: Distributed as 21 multi-part split zips (Task_1.zip.001-014 + Task_2.zip.001-007, ~21.8 GB). After download, reassemble with `cat Task_1.zip.* > Task_1.zip` then extract with 7-Zip. The Zenodo files are marked CC BY 4.0. Check any separate challenge rules before entering a competition.

datasets.name: mbrset
datasets.description: 5,164 fundus images from 1,291 patients captured with the Phelcom Eyer handheld smartphone-based fundus camera. Labels for DR grading + clinical/demographic prediction.
datasets.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (Research only)
datasets.source_terms: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (Research only)
datasets.citation: Wu C, Restrepo D, Nakayama LF, et al., 'A portable retina fundus photos dataset for clinical, demographic, and diabetic retinopathy prediction', Scientific Data 12:323, 2025. doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04627-3
datasets.notes: Same PhysioNet credentialed flow as BRSET. Modality EyeDataHub otherwise lacks (portable smartphone-based fundus).

datasets.name: mcoa
datasets.full_name: MCOA: Multimodal Corneal Opacity Assessment Dataset
datasets.description: 6,272 AS-OCT images + 392 anterior-segment photographs for corneal opacity assessment with expert grading. First large public multimodal AS-OCT + photo dataset for cornea.
datasets.citation: Ma X, et al., 'MCOA: A comprehensive multimodal dataset for advancing deep learning in corneal opacity assessment', Scientific Data 2025.
datasets.notes: Anterior-segment expansion; modality otherwise sparse.

datasets.name: messidor2
datasets.description: 1748 fundus images with DR grading (0-3 Retinopathy Grade) and macular edema risk (0-2).
datasets.citation: Decencière et al., 'Feedback on a publicly distributed image database: the Messidor database', Image Analysis & Stereology 2014.
datasets.notes: Free registration required at adcis.net before downloading.

datasets.name: mfiddr
datasets.full_name: MFIDDR: Multi-Field Imaging Dataset for Diabetic Retinopathy
datasets.description: 34,452 fundus images from 4,344 patients across multiple fields per eye, with DR screening labels. Largest public four-field DR dataset.
datasets.citation: MFIDDR Multi-Field Imaging Dataset for DR. github.com/mfiddr/MFIDDR
datasets.notes: Google Form gates the Drive link — no static download ID.

datasets.name: mgd1k
datasets.description: One thousand infrared meibography images with meibomian-gland masks, eyelid masks, and six rounds of expert meiboscore grading.
datasets.license: Unknown; project page states All Rights Reserved
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; project page states All Rights Reserved
datasets.citation: Saha RK, Chowdhury AM, Na KS, Hwang GD, Eom Y, Kim J, Jeon HG, Hwang HS, Chung E. Automated quantification of meibomian gland dropout in infrared meibography using deep learning. The Ocular Surface. 2022;26:283-294.
datasets.notes: Official project page reports 1,000 infrared meibomian-gland images from 320 patients, 1,000 gland masks, 1,000 eyelid masks, and six meiboscore rounds. License is not explicit; verify source terms before reuse.

datasets.name: migs_video
datasets.full_name: Multicenter Fine-Annotated MIGS Surgical Video Dataset
datasets.description: A multicenter collection of 186 minimally invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS) videos with annotations for surgical-phase recognition and semantic segmentation of instruments and anatomical structures.

datasets.notes: The current Zenodo version is 10.5281/zenodo.19438128 under CC BY 4.0; the version-independent concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.18231908. The associated article cites the earlier deposit version 10.5281/zenodo.18231909.

datasets.name: mm_retinal_reason
datasets.description: Ophthalmology-specific multimodal reasoning dataset built from 45 public datasets. Chain-of-thought reasoning traces for retinal VQA.
