datasets.source_terms: Mixed (inherits from 45 source datasets) — verify per-row
datasets.citation: MM-Retinal-Reason: Ophthalmology multimodal reasoning dataset. HuggingFace, 2025.
datasets.notes: Aggregates 45 source datasets — image licenses inherit; verify per-row before commercial use.

datasets.name: mmrdr
datasets.full_name: MMRDR: Multi-Modal Retinal Diabetic Retinopathy Dataset
datasets.description: Multi-modal DR dataset combining color fundus photographs (CFP), OCT B-scans, and ultra-widefield (UWF) fundus images, annotated for DR detection and severity grading. Published in Nature Scientific Data 2026.
datasets.citation: MMRDR: Multi-Modal Retinal Diabetic Retinopathy Dataset. Nature Scientific Data 2026. Figshare: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.29423747 — GitHub: https://github.com/Vladimirovich2019/MMRDR_Evaluation
datasets.notes: Contains 24,460 images across CFP, OCT, and UWF modalities. The source-reported unit is images rather than unique patients. Evaluation code: https://github.com/Vladimirovich2019/MMRDR_Evaluation

datasets.name: mpii_gaze
datasets.description: Longitudinal laptop-camera images captured during natural daily use with gaze targets, face geometry, and normalized views.
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; non-commercial scientific use only
datasets.source_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; non-commercial scientific use only
datasets.citation: Zhang X, Sugano Y, Fritz M, Bulling A. Appearance-Based Gaze Estimation in the Wild. CVPR. 2015:4511-4520.
datasets.notes: The institutional page reports 213,659 images from 15 participants collected over more than three months and provides a 2.1 GB download for non-commercial scientific use.

datasets.name: mshf
datasets.full_name: Multi-Source Heterogeneous Fundus Dataset for Image Quality Assessment
datasets.description: Multi-source heterogeneous retinal fundus image-quality assessment dataset for training and evaluating quality-control models.
datasets.citation: Jin K, Gao Z, Jiang X, Wang Y, Ma X, Li Y, Ye J. MSHF: A Multi-Source Heterogeneous Fundus Dataset for Image Quality Assessment. Figshare, 2023. doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.21507564
datasets.notes: Multi-source quality-assessment dataset; review source composition before treating all images as a single independent cohort.

datasets.name: msila_fundus_dr
datasets.full_name: M'Sila Retinal Fundus Dataset for Diabetic Retinopathy Classification
datasets.description: Anonymized retinal fundus images from an ophthalmology clinic in M'Sila, Algeria for diabetic-retinopathy classification.
datasets.citation: M'Sila retinal fundus dataset for diabetic retinopathy classification. Zenodo, 2026. doi:10.5281/zenodo.19169587

datasets.name: multieye

datasets.notes: Re-aggregates several source datasets — image licenses inherit from their original sources. Verify per-component before reuse.

datasets.name: mured
datasets.description: 2,208 color fundus images with 20-class multi-label disease annotations.

datasets.name: myopic_regression_fundus

datasets.description: Public sample fundus photographs and measurements for modeling myopic regression after corneal refractive surgery.

datasets.notes: Public sample release; not the full original clinical study dataset.

datasets.name: nd_iris_0405
datasets.description: Longitudinal near-infrared iris images with subject, eye, age, sex, and ethnicity metadata used in ICE iris-recognition evaluations.

datasets.source_terms: Research use under a signed institutional data license agreement

datasets.name: nehut

datasets.name: ochid
datasets.description: A collection of 640 retinal OCT images with expert choroidal region annotations for choroid segmentation.

datasets.source_terms: Research only: academic research use by request

datasets.notes: The official project page asks academic users to request the dataset by email. It does not provide a standard license.

datasets.name: oct5k
datasets.description: 1,672 OCT B-scans from AMD, DME, and healthy controls with 5,016 multi-grader layer annotations + lesion detection labels.

datasets.notes: UCL Research Data Repository — Figshare-backed, free download.

datasets.name: oct_c8

datasets.name: oct_cirrus

datasets.name: oct_ms_jhu

datasets.name: octa_500

datasets.name: octa_macula_coronal

datasets.name: octave

IOVS 2025.
datasets.citation: Kermany DS et al., 'Identifying Retinal Features Using a Self-Configuring CNN for Clinical Intervention', Investigative Ophthalmology & Visual Science 66(6):55 (2025). doi:10.1167/iovs.66.6.55 — Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/14580071

datasets.name: octdl

datasets.citation: Kulyabin et al., 'OCTDL: Optical Coherence Tomography Dataset for Image-Based Deep Learning Methods', Scientific Data 2024.

datasets.name: octid
datasets.description: 500 OCT images: NORMAL (206), AMD (50), CSC (128), DR (59), MH (57). High-resolution B-scans for 5-class classification.
datasets.citation: Gholami et al., 'OCTID: Optical Coherence Tomography Image Database', Elsevier 2020.
datasets.notes: Freely available from Borealis Data Repository. No account required.

datasets.name: ocular_chat_vqa
datasets.description: 844,000 simulated patient-physician dialogue rows generated from AREDS clinical visits. Enables ophthalmic dialogue and counseling VLM training.

datasets.name: oculoscope
datasets.full_name: OculoScope: Fairer AI in Ophthalmology Dataset

datasets.citation: FairerOPTH Study — OculoScope Dataset. Nature Communications 2024. https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-48972-0 — Data: https://figshare.com/s/926c2c2ef9e77ab5eb9d
datasets.notes: Also annotates 67 fine-grained fundus features in addition to 38 disease-level labels. Full class list in dataset CSV.

datasets.name: odir2019
datasets.description: 8000 patients (16000 fundus images, left + right eye) with 8 disease labels for multi-label ocular disease classification.
datasets.citation: Li et al., 'An Annotation-Free Restoration Network for Cataractous Fundus Images', arXiv 2021.

datasets.name: oimhs
datasets.full_name: OIMHS: OCT Image Macular Hole Segmentation Dataset
datasets.description: 3,859 OCT B-scan images (125 eyes, 119 patients) for macular hole segmentation. Each PNG is side-by-side: left half raw B-scan, right half colour-coded mask for 4 classes: Retina, Macular Hole, Intraretinal Cysts, Choroid.
datasets.citation: Ye X et al., 'OIMHS: An Optical Coherence Tomography Image Dataset Based on Macular Hole Manual Segmentation', Scientific Data 10, 769 (2023). doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02675-1
datasets.notes: Images are side-by-side PNGs (left=raw, right=mask). 125 eye-level subfolders under images/. No official split — apply your own train/val/test division.

datasets.name: olives
datasets.full_name: OLIVES: Ophthalmic Labels for Investigating Visual Eye Semantics
datasets.description: Longitudinal OCT + fundus dataset from AMD/DME patients across multiple clinical visits. 9,408 OCT B-scans have biomarker labels for 8 categories (fluid, drusen, scarring, PED variants, etc.); 78,000+ images include clinical measurements (BCVA, CST). Also includes 1,268 paired fundus photographs.
datasets.citation: Prabhushankar M et al., 'OLIVES Dataset: Ophthalmic Labels for Investigating Visual Eye Semantics', NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks 2022. https://zenodo.org/records/7105232
datasets.notes: 9,408 biomarker-labelled B-scans from 96 patients (6 clinical visits × 49 B-scans/visit). Full OCT volume set ~62,000 B-scans. Also available on HuggingFace: gOLIVES/OLIVES_Dataset. Contains paired fundus photos and clinical metadata.

datasets.name: ophnet2024
datasets.description: Large-scale multi-procedure ophthalmic surgical video dataset covering 66 surgery types, 102 phases, 150 operations (~285 h). 1,969 untrimmed videos; 17,508 trimmed operation-level clips; 14,674 trimmed phase-level clips across cataract, vitreoretinal, glaucoma, corneal, refractive, oculoplastic, and strabismus. 743 videos have time-boundary annotations. ECCV 2024.
datasets.citation: Hu M et al., 'OphNet: A Large-Scale Video Benchmark for Ophthalmic Surgical Workflow Understanding', ECCV 2024. arXiv:2406.07471. HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xioamiyh/OphNet2024 — GitHub: https://github.com/minghu0830/OphNet-benchmark
datasets.notes: ~583 GB total: untrimmed ~305 GB, trimmed operations ~139 GB, trimmed phases ~139 GB, features ~26 GB. num_samples = 2,278 source videos. May require HF_TOKEN for gated access. Set HF_TOKEN in .env. GitHub: https://github.com/minghu0830/OphNet-benchmark

datasets.name: ophora

datasets.notes: 162,185 video clip-instruction pairs from 9,819 source videos (avg clip length ~5.5 s). Estimated ~500 GB total. Video clip-instruction pair dataset for text-guided surgical video generation. May require HF_TOKEN for gated access. Set in .env.

datasets.source_terms: See repo (no LICENSE file as of 2026-06; assume research-only)
datasets.citation: Xu et al., 'SLID: Slit-Lamp Image Dataset', Frontiers Digital Health 2025. doi:10.3389/fdgth.2025.1716501
datasets.notes: Modality EyeDataHub otherwise lacks (slit-lamp anterior-segment). Annotations CSV is at github.com/xumingyu-hub/SLID/raw/main/Annotations.csv.

datasets.name: smdg
datasets.description: ~12,000 fundus images aggregated from 19 public glaucoma datasets with standardized disc/cup/vessel channels and unified labels. CC0 — fully public domain.
datasets.citation: Kiefer, 'Standardized Multi-channel Dataset for Glaucoma (SMDG-19)', Kaggle 2022. Breakdown: 7,499 non-glaucoma + 4,817 glaucoma + 133 suspect.
datasets.notes: Aggregator — overlaps with several EyeDataHub-indexed glaucoma datasets. Useful for unified multi-source training.

datasets.name: soul_octa
datasets.full_name: SOUL: OCTA Human-Machine Collaborative Annotation Dataset
datasets.description: Longitudinal OCT angiography projection maps with vessel labels, clinical text, and treatment/follow-up groupings.
datasets.citation: Xue J, Feng Z, Zeng L, et al. Soul: An OCTA dataset based on Human Machine Collaborative Annotation Framework. Scientific Data. 2024;11. doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03665-7
datasets.notes: The six source-reported longitudinal subsets total 178 samples. The release includes raw images, vessel annotations, and clinical text.

datasets.name: stage_task1
datasets.full_name: STAGE 2023 Task 1 — Mean Deviation Prediction from OCT
datasets.description: 400 macular OCT volumes; predict glaucoma Mean Deviation (MD, dB) from 24-2 Humphrey visual field test. Scalar regression task.
datasets.citation: MICCAI 2023 STAGE Challenge. https://aistudio.baidu.com/aistudio/competition/detail/968
datasets.notes: Registration on Baidu AI Studio required. All 3 tasks share the same OCT volume set (~5 GB).

datasets.name: stage_task2
datasets.full_name: STAGE 2023 Task 2 — Visual Field Sensitivity Map Prediction
datasets.description: 400 macular OCT volumes; predict 52-point Humphrey 24-2 visual field sensitivity map (0–100 dB per point). Multi-output regression.
datasets.citation: MICCAI 2023 STAGE Challenge. https://aistudio.baidu.com/aistudio/competition/detail/968
datasets.notes: Labels in task2_GT_training.xlsx (52 columns per sample). All 3 tasks share the same OCT volume set.

datasets.name: stage_task3
datasets.full_name: STAGE 2023 Task 3 — Pattern Deviation Probability Map
datasets.description: 400 macular OCT volumes; predict 52-point pattern deviation probability map from 24-2 Humphrey visual field test. Multi-output regression.
datasets.citation: MICCAI 2023 STAGE Challenge. https://aistudio.baidu.com/aistudio/competition/detail/968

datasets.name: stare
datasets.full_name: STARE: Structured Analysis of the Retina
datasets.description: 20 fundus images with manual vessel segmentation (two annotators).
datasets.citation: Hoover et al., 'Locating blood vessels in retinal images by piece-wise threshold probing of a matched filter response', IEEE TMI 2000.

datasets.name: superccm_fineset
datasets.description: Restricted corneal confocal microscopy image set with pixel-level corneal-nerve masks annotated for high-precision segmentation.
datasets.citation: Qiao Q. SuperCCM-FineSet. Zenodo, 2025. doi:10.5281/zenodo.17051148
datasets.notes: Zenodo record is publicly visible, but files are restricted; source instructions request an email application with name, organization, and intended use.

datasets.name: sustech_sysu
datasets.description: 1,219 color fundus images with DR severity grading + pixel-level exudate segmentation masks. Multi-center (SUSTech + Sun Yat-sen University).
datasets.citation: Lin et al., 'The SUSTech-SYSU dataset for automated exudate detection and diabetic retinopathy grading', Scientific Data 2020.

datasets.name: syn_oct
datasets.description: Synthetic circumpapillary OCT images for healthy and glaucomatous eyes with retinal-layer masks and RNFL thickness values.
datasets.citation: SYN-OCT: A synthetic dataset of ocular optical coherence tomography images from healthy and glaucoma eyes. Scientific Data. 2026. doi:10.1038/s41597-026-06946-5
datasets.notes: Contains 100,000 synthetic glaucoma and 100,000 synthetic normal circumpapillary OCT images. No real patient images are released.

datasets.name: tear_meniscus
datasets.description: 1,693 color and 1,739 infrared ocular-surface images from five clinical centers with pixel-level tear-meniscus segmentation. First multi-center dry-eye imaging benchmark.
datasets.citation: Multicentre tear meniscus segmentation dataset, Scientific Data 2025.
datasets.notes: Figshare marks the deposited files CC BY 4.0. Adds a dry-eye and tear-film modality that is otherwise absent.

datasets.name: teyed
datasets.description: Head-mounted eye images with pupil, iris, eyelid, eyeball, gaze, landmark, segmentation, and eye-movement annotations.
datasets.license: Unknown; public FTP is described in the paper but no license is stated
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; public FTP is described in the paper but no license is stated
datasets.citation: Fuhl W, Kasneci G, Kasneci E. TEyeD: Over 20 Million Real-World Eye Images with Rich 2D and 3D Annotations. arXiv:2102.02115. 2021.
datasets.notes: The paper reports 20,666,096 open- or closed-eye frames and also 200,977 no-eye frames, collected with seven trackers. It documents anonymous FTP access at nephrit.cs.uni-tuebingen.de using user TEyeDUser, but does not state a standard dataset license; confirm availability and terms before use.

datasets.name: thoct1800
datasets.description: A collection of 1,800 preprocessed retinal OCT B-scans, with 600 images each for AMD, diabetic macular edema, and normal retina.
datasets.license: Research only: research and educational use
datasets.source_terms: Research only: research and educational use
datasets.citation: THOCT1800 retinal OCT image dataset. OCT-Segmentation project. GitHub.
datasets.notes: The official repository permits research and educational use and asks users to cite the project. No standard license file is present.

datasets.name: thyroid_ophthalmopathy_external
datasets.description: External ocular photographs of thyroid eye disease collected from web sources, with surgery-related images removed by the source curator.
datasets.citation: Yoo T. Thyriod ophthalmopathy - external ocular images. Mendeley Data, V2, 2024. doi:10.17632/z7ys7r4bdn.2
datasets.notes: Source title spells thyroid as 'Thyriod'. Web-sourced photographs; verify image provenance before clinical validation or redistribution.

datasets.name: tian_oct
datasets.full_name: Tian OCTRIMA 3D OCT Layer Segmentation Dataset
datasets.description: 10 Heidelberg Spectralis SD-OCT volumes (510 B-scans, 496×644×51 voxels) from healthy subjects with 8 retinal layer boundary annotations by 2 independent observers. MATLAB .mat format; used as the OCTRIMA 3D validation set.
datasets.citation: Tian J et al., 'Real-Time Automatic Segmentation of Optical Coherence Tomography Volume Data of the Macular Region', PLOS ONE 10(8):e0133908 (2015). doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0133908
datasets.notes: Primarily a benchmark/test set (10 volumes, 2 observers). Each .mat file contains: raw OCT volume, OCTRIMA 3D automatic segmentation, Observer 1 manual, Observer 2 manual. Supplement URL: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0133908.s002

datasets.name: tom500
datasets.full_name: TOM500: Multi-Organ Annotated Orbital MRI Dataset for Thyroid Eye Disease
datasets.description: T2-weighted orbital MRI volumes with multi-organ segmentation labels (extraocular muscles, optic nerve, lacrimal gland, orbital fat) and paired clinical data. First public orbital MRI benchmark for thyroid eye disease.
datasets.citation: Zhang H, et al., 'TOM500: A multi-organ annotated orbital MRI dataset for thyroid eye disease', Scientific Data 2025.
datasets.notes: Adds orbital MRI; modality outside typical ophthalmic imaging.

datasets.name: toxofundus
datasets.description: Fundus photographs for ocular toxoplasmosis detection: active toxoplasmosis, inactive (scarred) lesions, and normal. ~412 images total (adult + pediatric cases).
datasets.citation: Nafisi & Sadri, 'ToxoFundus: Ocular Toxoplasmosis Fundus Image Dataset', Data in Brief 2023. Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/5156953 — Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/nafin59/ocular-toxoplasmosis-fundus-images-dataset

datasets.name: trend2_fundus
datasets.full_name: TREND2 Chronic Disease Portable Fundus Dataset
datasets.description: Extension of TREND portable fundus imaging for chronic-disease and microvascular analysis.
datasets.citation: TREND2 chronic disease portable fundus dataset. Zenodo, 2023. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7678656

datasets.name: trend_fundus
datasets.full_name: TREND Portable Fundus Microvascular Network Dataset
datasets.description: Portable fundus images and segmentations for retinal microvascular network analysis.
datasets.citation: TREND portable fundus microvascular network dataset. Zenodo, 2021. doi:10.5281/zenodo.4521044

datasets.name: tsukazaki_uwf
datasets.description: 13,047 ultra-widefield fundus photographs (Optos, 200° FOV) from Tsukazaki Hospital, annotated with 8 binary disease labels: AO, AMD, DR, Glaucoma, MH, RD, RP, RVO. Associated with Scientific Data 2024.
datasets.license: Research only — contact authors for data access
datasets.source_terms: Research only — contact authors for data access
datasets.citation: Nagasawa T et al., 'Automatic detection of multiple retinal diseases in ultra-widefield fundus images using deep learning', Nature Machine Intelligence 2022. https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-022-00566-5 — Data: https://github.com/DateCazuki/Fundus_Diagnosis
datasets.notes: Full dataset is subject to Japanese export restrictions. Contact the authors for access. A public subset may be available via the GitHub repo or linked Figshare.

datasets.name: ubiris_v2
datasets.description: Visible-light iris images captured at a distance and on the move with realistic blur, reflection, occlusion, pose, and illumination noise.
datasets.license: Unknown; request access and verify UBIRIS.v2-specific terms
datasets.source_terms: Unknown; request access and verify UBIRIS.v2-specific terms
datasets.citation: Proenca H, Filipe S, Santos R, Oliveira J, Alexandre LA. The UBIRIS.v2: A Database of Visible Wavelength Iris Images Captured On-the-Move and At-a-Distance. IEEE TPAMI. 2010;32:1529-1535.
datasets.notes: The official readme reports 11,102 images from 261 participants and 522 irises. The site states that UBIRIS.v1 is public and that newer UBIPr derivatives use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but it does not make the same license statement for UBIRIS.v2; terms are therefore unknown.

datasets.name: umn_parhi_oct
datasets.full_name: UMN Parhi Lab AMD OCT Fluid Segmentation Dataset
datasets.description: 600 Spectralis OCT B-scans from 24 exudative AMD subjects. Three fluid region classes: IRF, SRF, PED. Dual expert annotation.
datasets.citation: Parhi Lab OCT AMD Fluid Dataset. http://people.ece.umn.edu/users/parhi/data-and-code/

datasets.name: ut_fsocta
datasets.full_name: UTHealth Fundus and Synthetic OCTA Dataset
datasets.description: Fundus and synthetic OCTA vessel-segmentation resource for domain-transfer research.
datasets.citation: UTHealth fundus and synthetic OCTA dataset. Zenodo, 2022. doi:10.5281/zenodo.6476639

datasets.name: uveitis_smote
datasets.full_name: Image Dataset on Eye Diseases Classification with Symptoms and SMOTE Validation
datasets.description: Image and symptom dataset for normal, uveitis, conjunctivitis, cataract, and eyelid-drooping classification, with source-reported SMOTE balancing to 649 images per class.
datasets.citation: Bitto AK, Ahmed M. Image Dataset on Eye Diseases Classification (Uveitis, Conjunctivitis, Cataract, Eyelid) with Symptoms and SMOTE Validation. Mendeley Data, V2, 2024. doi:10.17632/n9zp473wfw.2
datasets.notes: Web-sourced images and SMOTE-based synthetic balancing are reported. Use original images, not synthetic oversampling, for clinical validation where possible.

datasets.name: uwf_dr
datasets.description: Ultra-widefield fundus photographs for diabetic retinopathy grading (5-level ICDR scale). Released alongside the Reasoning-Enhanced VLM paper for interpretable UWF DR detection. Related to the UWF4DR 2024 MICCAI challenge (~495 images across image quality and DR grading tasks).
datasets.citation: Reasoning-Enhanced Vision-Language Model for Interpretable Diabetic Retinopathy Detection in Ultra-Wide-Field Fundus Images. OMIA 2025 (MICCAI Workshop), Springer. DOI: 10.1007/978-3-032-10351-2_12

datasets.name: uwf_dr_peng
datasets.full_name: UWF Fundus DR Dataset (Peng et al., 2026)
datasets.description: 1,630 Optos ultra-wide-field fundus images from 809 patients graded for diabetic retinopathy (5-class ICDR) by senior ophthalmologists.
datasets.citation: Peng et al., 'A UWF fundus DR dataset with senior-ophthalmologist labels', Scientific Data 2026. doi:10.1038/s41597-026-07093-7

datasets.name: uwf_tumor
datasets.description: 2,031 ultra-widefield fundus images for AI-assisted intraocular tumor detection and classification. Six categories: Normal, Choroidal Hemangioma (CH), Retinal Capillary Hemangioma (RCH), Choroidal Osteoma (CO), Retinoblastoma (RB), Uveal Melanoma (UM). Annotated by 3 experts; split 8:1:1 (stratified).
datasets.citation: UWF Intraocular Tumor Dataset. Scientific Data 2025. https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-025-05864-2 — Figshare: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.27986258

datasets.name: uwf_zhejiang
datasets.full_name: Open UWF Fundus Dataset with Disease + Quality Labels
datasets.description: 700 Optos ultra-wide-field fundus images with multi-disease classification labels and image-quality flags from real-world clinical practice.
datasets.citation: He S, Ye X, Xie W, et al., 'Open ultrawidefield fundus image dataset with disease diagnosis and clinical image quality assessment', Scientific Data 11:1251, 2024. doi:10.1038/s41597-024-04113-2

datasets.name: uwhvf
datasets.full_name: UWHVF: University of Washington Humphrey Visual Field
datasets.description: 28,943 HFA 24-2 visual field tests with per-point sensitivities, MD/PSD indices, glaucoma labels, and longitudinal follow-up data. Input: 52-element sensitivity array (not an image).
datasets.citation: Boland et al., 'The University of Washington Humphrey Visual Field database', Ophthalmic Epidemiology 2022.
datasets.notes: Non-imaging dataset. Samples are 52-element visual field arrays. Models must accept 1D/2D VF arrays, not RGB images.

datasets.name: vietai_retinal_disease
datasets.description: A multilabel fundus classification challenge with 3,435 labeled training images and 350 test images covering six disease groups and normal findings.
datasets.citation: VietAI Advance Course Retinal Disease Detection. Kaggle. 2020.
datasets.notes: Kaggle authentication and acceptance of the competition rules may be required. Derivative archives that mix these images with unverified sources were excluded from the registry.

datasets.name: visual_field_testing_experiment
datasets.description: Visual-field and psychophysics experiment data for scotoma-detection comparisons.
datasets.citation: Visual Field Testing Experiment. Kaggle, accessed 2026-07.

datasets.name: x_pcr
datasets.full_name: X-PCR Ophthalmology Progressive Clinical Reasoning Benchmark
datasets.description: The version-pinned public deposit contains 18,735 ophthalmic image-text benchmark rows across CFP, external-eye, FFA, OCT, and RetCam subsets.
datasets.citation: Fantasy666/X-PCR. Hugging Face dataset, accessed 2026-07.
datasets.notes: The public deposit at commit 06a318fd852230326386e3c6514d8a11b7a6b4af has 18,735 rows. The dataset card describes a broader benchmark of 26,415 images and 177,868 VQA pairs; these units and scopes are not interchangeable.
